rows.name: Free Sample

rows.name: Grappling Hook

rows.name: Growth Ring

rows.name: Loading Screen Tip

rows.name: Loose Floorboard

rows.name: Masterclass

rows.name: Midas Gauntlet

rows.name: Monks of the Fifth Bell

rows.name: Olympus Voicemail
rows.effect: For your next 2 turns, after each of your moves a bolt stuns the enemy piece that moved most recently (kings excluded) for 1 turn.

rows.name: Overdue Library Book

rows.name: Poltergeist

rows.name: Portal Pair

rows.name: Private Gallery

rows.name: Raven Parliament

rows.name: Rubber Stamp

rows.effect: After your next capture, immediately take a second move that cannot capture, once.

rows.name: Monkeytype
rows.effect: Type at full speed: relocate up to 2 of your pieces, each exactly one square, in a rapid burst of keystrokes. Kings sit this test out.

rows.name: Mystery Box
rows.effect: Rattle the crate and pop the lid: your next draft offer rolls at a completely random tier, anywhere from 2 to 7.

rows.name: One Arm Muscle Up Is My Dream
rows.effect: One chosen piece reaches for the bar: once, it may slide diagonally like a bishop, one long arm across the board. That reach is a single grasp, taking it spends it, and so does the first of your turns where the reach is available but you move without using it.

rows.name: Backseat Gamer
rows.effect: A suggested move flashes on your opponent's board. If their next move is anything else, you gain 13 seconds, one of your pawns advances one square for free, and you gain a draft reroll. In untimed games only the free pawn step and the reroll apply.

rows.name: Bake Sale
rows.effect: Gain 15 seconds now. For your next 5 turns, every pawn move you make sells another cookie for 5 more seconds. You also gain one draft reroll and see the tier of your opponent's next draft. In untimed games only the reroll and the reveal apply.

rows.name: Bodyswap Ball
rows.effect: The disco ball drops: two random pieces in your army swap squares, and two random pieces in your opponent's army swap squares. Kings sit the dance out.

rows.name: Booster Pack
rows.effect: Tear the foil: immediately receive one random tier-4 card, fair odds.

rows.name: Chat Vote
rows.effect: Chat votes on your prize, winner random: gain 25 seconds, every one of your pawns with an open square ahead advances one, or a random enemy minor is stunned for 1 turn.

rows.name: Compound Interest
rows.effect: The vault locks for 6 of your turns. When it opens, if your queen is still on the board: your next draft offers three cards and you gain 20 seconds. If she is gone, the investment is lost.

rows.name: Draft Dodger
rows.effect: Dodge your next draft entirely: gain 30 seconds now, and the draft after that offers 3 cards instead of 2. One of your pawns also advances one square for free and you gain one draft reroll. In untimed games only the free pawn step and the reroll apply.

rows.name: Dragon Egg
rows.effect: Place an egg (an immobile pawn) on an empty square in your half. After 6 of your turns it hatches into a queen; every 3 of your turns after hatching, the wyrm devours one random enemy pawn adjacent to it. If the egg is captured first, nothing hatches.

rows.name: Emote Wheel
rows.effect: Hold the emote wheel for 6 of your turns. Once, drop a devastating GG on one enemy piece adjacent to any of your pieces: it is stunned for 1 turn.

rows.name: Feng Shui Plot
rows.effect: Claim a 2x2 plot for 6 of your turns: your pieces standing inside it may also step one square in any direction, but that step cannot capture.

rows.name: Fire Drill
rows.effect: Sound the alarm on one rank of your half: swap pairs of your pieces standing on it, up to 3 swaps, then everyone pretends this was orderly.

rows.name: Focus Group
rows.effect: The focus group files its report: you see the cards of your opponent's next draft.

rows.name: Frog Prince
rows.effect: Turn one enemy knight or bishop into a frog for your opponent's next 3 turns: it may only hop one square diagonally and cannot capture. Knights cannot hop at all and just ribbit.

rows.name: Glass Bridge
rows.effect: Choose one of the four central ranks: it turns to glass for 4 of your turns. Any piece of either side that ends a move there has a 50% chance to fall through and be removed. Kings are exempt.

rows.name: Identity Crisis
rows.effect: One random minor piece of yours and one random enemy minor swap sides. After 4 of your turns, each one still on the board swaps back.

rows.name: Insider Trading
rows.effect: See the cards of your opponent's next draft, and pocket 10 seconds for the tip.

rows.name: Knight Court
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns, your knights may also step one square straight up, down, or sideways. The court frowns on diagonals.

rows.name: Night Shift
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns, your rooks may move straight through your own pawns, but these moves cannot capture.

rows.name: Petting Zoo
rows.effect: A Goat, a Duck, and a Sheep (a pawn each) appear on random empty squares in your half for 8 of your turns. They cannot move or capture, they just block, then they wander home.

rows.name: Pillow Fort
rows.effect: For your opponent's next turn, their bishops, rooks and queen cannot move to any square from which they would attack your king. Knights and pawns may still menace.

rows.name: Prophecy Engine
rows.effect: Point at an enemy piece: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every move they make with that piece type gains you 6 seconds. If they never move one, the engine pays 40 seconds when the prophecy closes.

rows.name: Quicksilver
rows.effect: Your queen's next move may bend once at 90 degrees: up to 7 squares in total, the whole path must be clear, the corner square must be empty, and the destination must be empty (it cannot capture).

rows.name: Royal Wedding
rows.effect: Usable while your king and queen stand adjacent: place up to 2 pawns on empty squares beside either of them, and gain 20 seconds.

rows.name: Tax Audit
rows.effect: Audit both armies: your opponent loses 15 seconds for every piece they hold beyond your count, up to 50. If they are not ahead in material the audit finds nothing. Either way you gain a reroll and see their next draft's tier. Untimed: reroll and reveal only.

rows.name: Templar Vows
rows.effect: Choose one of your bishops: for 6 of your turns it is a Templar and may also make knight leaps onto empty squares. These leaps cannot capture.

rows.name: Thunderstorm
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, lightning strikes a random square in their half after each of their moves, destroying any enemy pawn standing there.

rows.name: Trojan Pawn
rows.effect: Choose one of your pawns: if it is captured within 8 of your turns, two fresh pawns leap out onto empty squares adjacent to where it fell.

rows.name: Wizard Duel
rows.effect: One of your bishops duels an enemy bishop: 50% either way, the loser is removed. If your bishop wins, it also gains single king steps for 3 of your turns.

rows.name: Overclock
rows.effect: Your knights move like knights or kings for 3 turns. The added king step cannot capture.

rows.name: Overtime Whistle
rows.effect: Blow the whistle for overtime: add 35 seconds to your own clock, flag the last enemy piece that moved until your opponent replies, and gain a draft reroll. In untimed games only the flag and the reroll apply.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Phase Rook
rows.effect: Choose one rook. For the game it may pass through one friendly piece per move; it still cannot capture friendly pieces or phase through two.

rows.name: Piece Steal
rows.effect: Convert one enemy pawn to your color, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Pin Breaker
rows.effect: One of your pieces breaks free with a knight's leap to an empty square and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, once. Using it spends the card even if the leap cannot resolve.

rows.name: Pinocchio
rows.effect: One pawn's nose grows: each of your turns it does not capture, its reach grows by one square, up to plus four. It may capture the first enemy piece other than a king directly ahead of it within that reach. Capturing shrinks the nose back to zero.

rows.name: Pixie Dust
rows.effect: A handful of glittering dust settles on your stables: for your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square diagonally.

rows.name: NerfChess Defender
rows.effect: Threat detected. A fake antivirus sweeps their board and quarantines up to 2 random enemy pieces: they cannot move for 2 of your opponent's turns. Kings are too big to quarantine.
rows.action: keep: 'NerfChess' in the name is the game title, not a mechanic reference; audit false positive

rows.name: Subscriber Raid
rows.effect: A fake donation alert blasts across the board: add 25 seconds to your clock while your opponent loses 10 to the chaos. You also gain a draft reroll and see the tier of their next offer. In untimed games only the reroll and the reveal apply.

rows.name: Raise Dead
rows.effect: Choose an empty square in your OPPONENT'S half now, and one of your fallen pawns, knights, or bishops rises there after your opponent's next move, once. If the square is taken by then, the revival fizzles and the charge is still spent.

rows.name: Regenerate
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, revive two of your captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

rows.name: Regroup
rows.effect: Return your advanced pawns to their starting rank where empty, once.

rows.name: Rewind One
rows.effect: Undo the last two half-moves: send the last piece each side moved back to the square it came from, once.

rows.name: Rubik's Cube
rows.effect: Scramble the cube: choose up to 3 twists, each swapping the spots of two of your own pieces standing within 2 squares of each other. Kings never twist. The twists only resolve after your opponent's next move.

rows.name: Screen
rows.effect: Choose one bishop. While it stands on a square next to your king it cannot be captured, for your next 6 turns.

rows.name: Seance
rows.effect: Send one of your knights or bishops across to the other side, and one of your captured rooks returns in its place, on the square that knight or bishop just vacated. Casting the circle also spends your next unused reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Shadow Step
rows.effect: One of your pieces slips through shadow to a nearby empty square and cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn, once.

rows.name: Shielded Advance
rows.effect: Choose one pawn. While it stands in the enemy half it cannot be captured, for your next 6 turns.

rows.name: Sliding King
rows.effect: Your king moves like a king or bishop for 3 turns.

rows.name: Split March
rows.effect: Four of your pawns each advance one square immediately, once. Using it spends the card even if fewer than four pawns can advance.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Starlight Ward
rows.effect: Starlight pools around the crown: your pieces standing on the squares beside your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Tempo Theft
rows.effect: Steal your opponent's next turn (you move twice, they wait), once. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Tidal Push
rows.effect: Choose one enemy piece and where it lands; after your opponent's next move, shove it two squares in a straight line if the path is still empty, once.

rows.name: Time Out
rows.effect: The referee throws a flag on your opponent: their next draft is skipped and their clock loses 15 seconds.

rows.name: Time Rewind
rows.effect: Turn back time: restore some of your clock and free all of your own frozen or petrified pieces, once.

rows.name: Time Thief
rows.effect: Pick your opponent's pocket: steal half of the time left on their clock (up to 75 seconds) and add it to your own.

rows.name: Trade Up
rows.effect: The next 2 times you lose a minor piece, a new pawn appears in your half.

rows.name: Trapdoor
rows.effect: Rig a spring on an empty square. For your next 4 turns, an enemy piece except a king that steps onto it is flung one square back toward its home rank and cannot move for 1 of their turns. A slapstick trap, not a delete.

rows.name: Arcane Conduit
rows.effect: One of your rooks may also move up to two squares diagonally, but never to capture, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Arcane Reroll
rows.effect: Gain two draft rerolls. Any you have not spent within your next two draft offers are reclaimed.
rows.action: REBALANCED: grants two rerolls (was one, strictly dominated by Peek T1 with the identical effect)

rows.name: Arrest the Hour
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy rook or queen for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Banish
rows.effect: Mark one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop: after your opponent replies, it is banished from the board, once.

rows.name: Chrono Siphon
rows.effect: Steal up to 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and freeze one enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Far Step
rows.effect: Teleport one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square on the board, once.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Ghostwalk
rows.effect: One of your bishops may also step one square straight, like a rook, but never to capture, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Spectral Retinue
rows.effect: Your retinue turns spectral and re-forms: your knights and bishops swap forms where they stand, knights becoming bishops and bishops becoming knights, but one of them is spared whenever more than one would change.

rows.name: Suppress Magic
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft offer contains no draft-manipulation cards, and the next buff they draft arrives nullified.

rows.name: Time Stop
rows.effect: Stop one piece in time, yours or theirs (never a king): for 2 of its owner's turns it cannot move, and for the first of those turns it cannot be captured. It is simply not here right now.

rows.name: Transmute
rows.effect: Turn one of your pawns into a knight, once. Using it also spends one of your draft rerolls, if you have any.

rows.name: Twin Blink
rows.effect: Two knots in the world come undone at once: choose one of your pieces and one enemy piece (kings aside); each blinks away to a random empty square.

rows.name: Wall
rows.effect: Raise a wall on one empty square you pick: enemy pieces can never move onto it, for the game. The wall only rises on an empty square and captures nothing.

rows.name: Warp Rook
rows.effect: One rook teleports to any empty square on the board, once.

rows.name: Warp Step
rows.effect: Move one piece up to three squares in a straight line to an empty square, passing over any pieces in between, once. It cannot capture.

rows.name: Wazir Bishop
rows.effect: Choose one bishop; for the game it may also step one square horizontally or vertically.

rows.name: Wazir Rook
rows.effect: Choose one rook; for the game it may also step one square diagonally.

rows.name: Black Hole
rows.effect: Open a black hole on one empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it, never a king, is swallowed off the board. It stays open for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Kangaroo Hop
rows.effect: One of your knights takes a little kangaroo hop: it may also step one square in any direction, once.

rows.name: Moonwalk
rows.effect: Teach your pawns to moonwalk: for your next 3 turns each of your pawns may also step one square straight backward onto an empty square. The backstep is never a capture.

rows.name: Pinata
rows.effect: Swing wildly and hope: one random enemy piece other than the king is knocked off the board, but one of your own pawns bursts in the mess and is lost too.

rows.name: Red Tape
rows.effect: Bury your opponent in paperwork: it takes a move to process, so after their next move they skip a turn, and then the forms catch up with you and you skip the turn after that.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Sacrificial Bishop
rows.effect: Feed one of your bishops to the volcano to smite one enemy knight or bishop you name: both leave the board, once.

rows.name: Tar Pit
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's bishops is stuck fast and cannot move or capture for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Cinder Strike
rows.effect: Remove one of your opponent's pawns from the board, once.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Gale
rows.effect: A driving wind opens gaps: for your next turn your bishops may each slip through one friendly piece in their way.

rows.name: Seedlings
rows.effect: Plant two seeds on empty squares in your half: they take root after your opponent's next move, and 3 of your turns later a pawn sprouts on each square that is still empty.

rows.name: Static Field
rows.effect: Static builds on anything that runs: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that travels 3 or more squares in one move without capturing is grounded, frozen for 1 turn where it lands.

rows.name: Stone Grip
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece, never a king, into a walnut for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. The enemy pieces directly beside it, up, down, left or right, cannot capture for their next 2 turns. Spends your next reroll if you have one.

rows.name: Whirlpool
rows.effect: A whirlpool drags one enemy pawn to your side and deposits it on an empty square of your 4th rank, never a capture, yours now and ready to advance.

rows.name: Will-o'-Wisp
rows.effect: A cold flame dances ahead of one enemy piece and it follows: lure one enemy piece except a king one square diagonally forward, toward your side, onto an empty square you choose. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Counter Charge
rows.effect: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, the capturing piece is frozen in place for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Dragoons
rows.effect: One of your knights trains to vault the line: it may also jump exactly two squares straight in any direction, over anything, for the game.

rows.name: Flank March
rows.effect: For up to your next 3 turns, each of your bishops may also step one square straight in any direction. This ends the first turn you play without taking one of those steps.

rows.name: Forced Retreat
rows.effect: Mark one enemy piece, a king aside: after your opponent's next move it is pushed one square directly away from your king, if that square is empty, once. Kings cannot be pushed.

rows.name: Phalanx Advance
rows.effect: Shields lock across the front: enemy pawns can never capture your pawns, save your single most advanced pawn (furthest forward, ties toward the a-file) whenever more than one of your pawns stands. For the rest of the game.

rows.name: Pikemen
rows.effect: One of your pawns may also move and capture one square sideways, for the game.

rows.name: Pontoon Bridge
rows.effect: One of your rooks, bishops, or queens may pass through up to two of your own pieces on its move, landing only on an empty square, once.

rows.name: Regroup the Lines
rows.effect: Sound the recall: every one of your pieces standing in the enemy half falls back one square toward home, wherever the square behind it is free.

rows.name: Reserve Cavalry
rows.effect: The reserve waits for the line to break: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a knight rides in on the empty back-rank square nearest your king's file.

rows.name: War Wagon
rows.effect: One of your bishops may also move, without capturing, up to two squares straight in any direction, for the game.

rows.name: All In
rows.effect: Push everything to the center. Your next draft offer is skipped. The offer after that shows three cards, and you take all three.

rows.name: Atomic Captures (Small)
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, your captures clear enemy pieces on the two squares beside the captured piece.

rows.name: Banner of War
rows.effect: Raise the banner and your cavalry surges: for your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square in any direction like a king.

rows.name: Berolina Pawns
rows.effect: Your pawns may also step diagonally forward to empty squares and capture straight ahead, for the game.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Bishop to Archbishop
rows.effect: One bishop also moves like a knight, for the game.
rows.action: keep: reviewed near-duplicate cluster; per-file or per-piece mirror family, or distinct mechanic confirmed

rows.name: Blockade
rows.effect: Wall the enemy front: their pawns cannot advance or capture for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Board Lock
rows.effect: The whole board seizes up: no enemy piece may travel more than 3 squares in a single move, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Bodyguard
rows.effect: Add a knight to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Borrowed Time
rows.effect: Your queen becomes uncapturable for your next 4 moves, and then her time runs out: she is removed from the board.

rows.name: Buff Thief (Minor)
rows.effect: Steal one tier 1 buff from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.
rows.action: keep: reviewed as the steal family's T4 entry (1 low-tier steal)

rows.name: Cascade Freeze
rows.effect: For 2 turns, each capture you make freezes the nearest enemy piece 1 turn.

rows.name: Chain Mail
rows.effect: All your minor pieces are uncapturable for 2 full turns.

rows.name: Chain Nullify
rows.effect: Cancel the next buff your opponent drafts before use.

rows.name: Rosen's Stafford Trap
rows.effect: Mark one of your knights or bishops as bait. If an enemy piece takes it within their next 3 turns, that piece is trapped in place for 2 of their turns and you gain 20 seconds. If nobody bites, the bait cannot be captured for 2 turns.

rows.name: Blackjack
rows.effect: The dealer feeds you cards until your hand reaches seventeen, then you stand. Twenty one pays a rook in your pocket and 45 seconds. Seventeen to twenty pays a minor piece. Bust and the house takes your weakest piece while you cool off for two turns.

rows.name: Poker Bluff
rows.effect: Shove all in holding nothing. Roughly forty five times in a hundred they fold, and you rake one of their pieces into the pot along with 20 seconds. The rest of the time they call, and you pay your weakest piece and take a two turn walk of shame.

rows.name: Day One Patch
rows.effect: The devs buffed pawns, but only in YOUR build: for your next 2 turns your pawns may also step one square diagonally forward onto empty squares (never onto the last rank).

rows.name: Deflect
rows.effect: Your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Direwolf Pack
rows.effect: Two spectral direwolves answer your howl: place two knights on empty squares in your half. The pack melts back into the mist after 5 of your turns. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Dragon Form
rows.effect: One of your rooks unfurls a pair of dragon wings for a single flight: choose a rook; until it next moves it may also slide diagonally like a queen, but the first move it makes, diagonal or straight, folds the wings and spends the charge.

rows.name: Dragon Mount
rows.effect: One of your knights breaks a young dragon to the saddle: for the game it may also slide any distance diagonally, though the dragon's glide cannot capture.

rows.name: Dragon Pawn
rows.effect: One pawn moves as a pawn or knight until it promotes.

rows.name: Excalibur
rows.effect: Draw the lake's blade: choose one of your bishops. Until it next moves it may also slide like a rook, giving it full queen movement, but the first move it makes, straight or diagonal, spends the blade.

rows.name: Fan Club
rows.effect: While you have as many or more pieces as your opponent, your pawns on your back three ranks cannot be captured. Fall behind on material and the cheering stops. Once two of those pawns have made a capture, the crowd goes home and the shield ends for good.

rows.name: Stormcaller
rows.effect: For your next 2 turns your rooks may also move diagonally and your bishops may also move straight, each as far as a queen would.

rows.name: Forearm Veins
rows.effect: Veins run dead straight up the forearm: after your opponent's next move, each of your pawns may also capture the enemy piece directly ahead of it, one square straight forward, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Giant Slayer
rows.effect: Your pawns carry slings and know the soft spots: twice this game, one of your pawns may capture an enemy piece on any square directly beside it. Each such capture consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Crash Game
rows.effect: Strap a pawn to the rocket and let it ride: 30% it lands with a free sidestep, 25% it comes back a knight, 20% a knight plus a draft reroll, 10% it comes back a ROOK, 15% the rocket crashes and the pawn burns up.

rows.name: Grand Recall
rows.effect: Return your queen (if on board) to any empty square in your half, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Guard Rotation
rows.effect: Swap your king with a rook anywhere on the board, once.

rows.name: Hallowed Return
rows.effect: A prayer is answered exactly: one of your captured knights, bishops, or rooks is restored to life on one of its own starting squares, if one is free, once.

rows.name: Hold the Bridge
rows.effect: One hero plants their feet: choose one of your knights, bishops, or rooks. It cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, but it stands its ground and cannot move for those turns either.

rows.name: Hunter Knight
rows.effect: One knight captures a piece one leap away and lands a second leap beyond, once.

rows.name: I Love Abs
rows.effect: Brace your core. Every one of your pieces standing in the central 16 squares becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Immobilizer
rows.effect: One piece freezes all adjacent enemy pieces except kings while it stands there. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Iron Bishop
rows.effect: One bishop cannot be captured by enemy pawns or knights, for the game.

rows.name: Iron Wall
rows.effect: Every piece on your back rank, your king aside, is uncapturable for 2 turns.

rows.name: King of the Hill
rows.effect: Your king rules the hill: while it stands on or beside one of the four center squares it may move like a queen, though those extended queen moves cannot capture.

rows.name: Kingslide
rows.effect: Your king slides any distance in a straight line to an empty square, once. This move cannot capture.

rows.name: Landlord
rows.effect: Claim four empty squares as your property. Any enemy piece (never a king) that ends its move on one of them owes rent: it is stuck fast for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Legendary Forge
rows.effect: The forge mends what war broke: one of your captured knights or bishops is reforged and returns to your pocket. Spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Mass Recall
rows.effect: Return any two pieces to your back rank, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Metamorphosis
rows.effect: Force a violent change of form on one of your own pawns, knights, or bishops: it reshapes itself into a rook, once. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Middle Part
rows.effect: Not one hair off the axis: choose one of your pieces except the king or queen, and a perfect mirror copy of it materializes on the file-reflected square (a-file to h-file), if that square is empty. Once.

rows.name: Mind Control
rows.effect: Choose one enemy knight or bishop; after your opponent's next move it turns to your color for the rest of the game, unless it has moved or been lost.

rows.name: Minor Recall
rows.effect: Return a captured knight or bishop to your back rank, once.

rows.name: Ancestral Audience
rows.effect: Revive your highest-value captured piece onto an empty square in your half. In fairness before the ancestors, your opponent's best captured pawn or minor returns to a random empty square in their half.

rows.name: Boomerang
rows.effect: One of your pieces throws: remove the first enemy pawn up to 3 squares away in a straight line with a clear flight path. On the return, if a friendly piece stands directly in front of the thrower, the catch stuns it for 1 turn.

rows.name: Cartographer's Vault
rows.effect: Your next 2 drafts each offer 3 cards.

rows.name: Demolition Derby
rows.effect: Choose a 3x3 arena: every piece inside except kings lurches one random square (blocked pieces stay put), and any two that crash into the same square are both wrecked.

rows.name: Dev Console
rows.effect: Open the console once and run the whole macro: spawn a pawn on a chosen empty square in your half, add 20 seconds to your clock, and dump your opponent's next draft offer to your screen.

rows.name: Flash Mob
rows.effect: Four pawns appear on random empty squares of your third rank. They hold the final pose (cannot move) for 1 turn.

rows.name: Golden Goose
rows.effect: Place a goose (a pawn stuck fast in golden honey) on an empty square in your half. For your next 8 turns it lays 6 seconds onto your clock after each of your moves. If it is captured, the gold stops.

rows.name: Growth Potion
rows.effect: Choose one of your knights: it is a Warhorse for 5 of your turns. Each time it captures a pawn, you immediately move again, but that bonus move cannot capture.

rows.name: Hall of Mirrors
rows.effect: For 3 of your turns, your rooks' horizontal moves wrap around the board edge, reappearing on the far file of the same rank. The wrap-around move cannot capture: it only lands on an empty square, and stops at the first piece it meets.

rows.name: Ivy Crown
rows.effect: Your king may lunge two squares in a straight line onto an empty square (the square between must also be empty). After each lunge the ivy rests for 3 of your turns.

rows.name: Lightning Rod
rows.effect: Bolt a rod onto one of your pieces (not the king). If it is captured within 6 of your turns, the storm answers: the capturer is destroyed too.

rows.name: Milkman's Round
rows.effect: Spawn a pawn on an empty square of your second rank now, and reserve a second square: in 3 of your turns another pawn is delivered there (or to any free second-rank square if yours got taken).

rows.name: Mole Tunnels
rows.effect: The tunnels do not open until after your opponent's next move. Then, for 5 of your turns, up to twice: one of your pawns may tunnel to the empty square directly behind an enemy pawn on its own file.

rows.name: Paperwork Avalanche
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any enemy piece that captures is buried in forms and cannot move on their following turn.

rows.name: Write the Patch Notes
rows.effect: Spend your turn: plant a new pawn on an empty square of your second rank, and your next draft is dealt exactly one tier higher.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Plot Armor
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces (king excluded): it cannot be captured during your opponent's next 6 turns. The script insists.

rows.name: Priest Hole
rows.effect: Once within 5 of your turns, while your king is in check: swap your king with one of your rooks standing on a square that is not currently attacked. Using this consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Rage Bait
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every capture they make costs them 6 seconds while the taunt plays.

rows.name: Regency Council
rows.effect: For 4 of your turns, while your queen is off the board your rooks and bishops may also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: Season Pass
rows.effect: Swipe the gold card: gain 3 draft rerolls.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Siege Ladder
rows.effect: Slap ladders on one file: for 3 of your turns, your rooks, bishops and queen may slide straight through enemy pawns standing on that file.

rows.name: Sleeping Draught
rows.effect: Dose one enemy knight or bishop. After your opponent's next move it falls asleep for their following 3 turns. It wakes early if any piece adjacent to it is captured.

rows.name: Stack Overflow
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, every move they make that is not a capture costs them 4 seconds. Closed as duplicate.

rows.name: Tasting Flight
rows.effect: Your next draft offers 3 cards instead of 2.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Time Heist
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn. 6 of your turns later the timeline collects: they take one extra move.

rows.name: Vampire Court
rows.effect: Up to 2 of your knights or bishops become vampires: each of their captures gains you 6 seconds, and the first time one is killed it returns 3 of your turns later on a square next to where it fell.

rows.name: Ventriloquist
rows.effect: Once, throw your voice: pick an enemy knight and make it perform a legal knight move of your choice to an empty square. No captures.

rows.name: Overclock Major
rows.effect: All your pieces may move like kings as an alternative, for 1 turn.

rows.name: Phalanx
rows.effect: Your entire pawn line becomes uncapturable for 2 turns.

rows.name: Phantom Guardian
rows.effect: Call up a phantom guardian: after your opponent's next move it appears and fights beside you as a bishop for 5 of your turns, then dissolves back into the aether.

rows.name: Phantom Rook
rows.effect: Choose an empty square in your half; after your opponent's next move a rook appears there and vanishes after 4 of your turns.

rows.name: Photosynthesis
rows.effect: After every 3 of your turns, one of your pawns advances a square on its own: the pawn nearest promotion with an empty square ahead. The step only ever moves onto an empty square, so it never captures, and never auto-advances onto the promotion rank.

rows.name: Pizza Delivery
rows.effect: The delivery scooter double-parks and the boxes pile up: choose three empty squares; your opponent's pieces cannot move onto them for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Captcha Check
rows.effect: Select all squares with a bicycle to continue. Verification fails: whichever piece type your opponent has moved the most is locked and cannot move for their next turn.

rows.name: Chain Letter
rows.effect: Forward to 10 friends or else: a cursed email hops around their army. One random enemy piece freezes each of your opponent's next 3 turns, jumping to a different piece every time. Never a king.

rows.name: Pop-up Storm
rows.effect: HOT DEALS raining on their side: plant 1 pop-up window on an empty square in your opponent's half. For your next 5 turns, any enemy piece that clicks onto it (a king is too careful to) is closed out of the game.

rows.name: Ratio'd
rows.effect: Nobody asked, plus you fell off: after your opponent's next move, if that move captured one of your pieces, the capturing piece gets bonked straight back toward its own side by up to 2 squares.

rows.name: Purge Two
rows.effect: Remove one enemy pawn, and freeze every other enemy pawn for their next turn.

rows.name: Rift Walker
rows.effect: One piece teleports anywhere on the board, once.

rows.name: Rook to Chancellor
rows.effect: One rook also moves like a knight, for the game.
rows.action: keep: reviewed near-duplicate cluster; per-file or per-piece mirror family, or distinct mechanic confirmed

rows.name: Royal Decree
rows.effect: Your king gains queen movement for up to 2 of your turns, but the decree is spent the first turn a decreed move is available and your king does not take it (the king still loses on capture).

rows.name: Sea Monkeys
rows.effect: Just add water: four tiny pawns hatch on random empty squares in your half and grow into real pawns.

rows.name: Second Army
rows.effect: Add two pawns to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Siege Rook
rows.effect: One rook slides along a clear rank or file to an empty square: it cannot capture, but the rank or file it travels stays barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Skibidi Flush
rows.effect: Up to 3 enemy pieces (never the king) are sent back to their home squares, or the nearest empty square toward home.

rows.name: Snooze Button
rows.effect: Pump sleeping gas down one file you pick: every enemy piece except the king standing on that file falls asleep and cannot move for their next turn.

rows.name: Solstice
rows.effect: The longest day gives everyone one more step: for your next turn, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: Split Bishop
rows.effect: Add a new bishop to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Sugar Rush
rows.effect: Slam a sugar rush: take three extra moves right now. Then comes the sugar crash and you skip your next turn.
rows.action: keep: bigger burst with a real cost; White Monster now trades size for safety

rows.name: Summon Knight
rows.effect: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, once.

rows.name: Suppress
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot draft manipulation buffs next draft. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.
rows.action: keep: suppress family T4 (pure category denial)

rows.name: Swap Meet
rows.effect: Set up a stall and shake on a deal: your lowest-tier held card and a random one of your opponent's held cards are swapped between you.

rows.name: The Tower
rows.effect: You deal your opponent the worst card in the deck: name one enemy rook. After your opponent's next move, it crumbles to rubble wherever it then stands.

rows.name: Total Recall
rows.effect: Pull each of your pieces past your 4th rank back to your 3rd rank where empty, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Tralalero Tralala
rows.effect: Dash any piece except the king to an empty square along its rank, file, or diagonal, blurring straight past anything between. For your opponent's next 2 turns it cannot be captured, but the blur burns out early once the sprinter has captured twice. Once.

rows.name: Twin Knights
rows.effect: Both knights become nightrooks, for the game.

rows.name: Understudy
rows.effect: The first time your queen is captured, one of your bishops, or a knight if you have no bishop, immediately turns into a queen on its own square. If you have neither, nothing happens. Triggers once.

rows.name: Bind the Queen
rows.effect: Arcane chains seize the enemy queen and every piece standing next to her: they cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Blink
rows.effect: Your king blinks: it trades places with one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, once.

rows.name: Borrowed Minute
rows.effect: Borrow one enemy knight for a minute: it fights for you for your next 2 turns, then walks back to their side, or returns the moment it makes a capture. If it dies meanwhile, the loan is settled.

rows.name: Conjured Bishop
rows.effect: Conjure your bishop's reflection: choose one of your bishops whose mirror square (same rank, file flipped left-to-right) is empty, and a new bishop appears there.

rows.name: Dominate
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy knight or bishop for your next 2 turns. When the time is up it reverts to your opponent.

rows.name: Glyph Seal
rows.effect: Seal one file: pick any square and its whole file becomes impassable to your opponent for their next turn, and every enemy piece already standing on it is bound in place for its next turn.

rows.name: High Roll
rows.effect: Force your next draft offer to roll at tier 5.
rows.action: keep: T4 rung of the forced-tier ladder (2->3->4->5->6 across T1->T5 with ov_window_shopping at the bottom)

rows.name: Mind Read
rows.effect: Your opponent's next drafted buff arrives nullified, and their reroll token slips away if they hold one.
rows.action: keep: nullify + reroll strip composite at T4

rows.name: Sigil Ward
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to move up next to it in that time is frozen for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Phase Field
rows.effect: One of your bishops slips half out of the world: each move it may pass through a single piece of either color, for the game. It still cannot capture its own side.

rows.name: Fold Space
rows.effect: Swap the squares of one pair of your own pieces, once.

rows.name: Void Rift
rows.effect: Tear a permanent rift on an empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it (never a king) is pulled out of the game, and any enemy piece that ends its move on a square next to the rift is frozen for its next turn.

rows.name: Warding Circle
rows.effect: You chalk a circle of old names around your throne: no enemy piece may end its move on any of the squares around your king, for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Warp Legion
rows.effect: The legion rallies to the crown: up to three of your pieces teleport to empty squares beside your king, once.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Warp Reign
rows.effect: Swap the positions of your king and queen and shield both for your opponent's next 3 turns. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Warp Sovereign
rows.effect: Swap up to three pairs of your pieces, once. Stop after any pair.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Warp Storm
rows.effect: Move up to four of your pieces, your king aside, one square each in any direction onto an empty square, once. The attempt is spent even if a chosen relocation turns out illegal when it resolves.

rows.name: Banana Peel Trail
rows.effect: Grease one file with banana peels: pieces may still enter, but the first enemy piece to do so slips one square back toward its home rank and cannot move next turn. An enemy king is too dignified to slip, but still treads the peels flat and spends them.

rows.name: Body Double
rows.effect: Slip one of your opponent's knights or bishops a better offer: they get one more move with it, then, after that reply, it switches to your side for the rest of the game, once. Kings cannot be swayed.

rows.name: Chaos Reigns
rows.effect: Fairness goes out the window: take one extra move right now, but your opponent also takes one extra move on their next turn.

rows.name: Clumsy Dash
rows.effect: Bolt for it and fumble: take one extra move right now, but one of your pawns is dropped and frozen in place for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Double Trouble
rows.effect: One of your knights or bishops splits in two: place its exact twin on an empty square right beside it.

rows.name: Haunted House
rows.effect: Two rooms turn haunted: mark two empty squares and any enemy piece that enters one, never a king, vanishes. The haunting lasts 3 of your turns.

rows.name: Juggling Act
rows.effect: Keep every plate spinning: take three extra moves right now, then it all comes crashing down and you skip your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Lost and Found
rows.effect: Dig through the lost and found: pick the empty square in your half where a captured piece other than the queen will return. It reappears only after your opponent's next move, and only if that square is still empty. The heaviest lost piece comes back first.

rows.name: Panic Button
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn, and you take one extra move right now to sort out the mess. The shield is defensive only: if a move leaves your king next to the enemy king, giving check, the shield pops at once.

rows.name: Voodoo Doll
rows.effect: Stitch a little doll of the enemy army: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a random enemy piece of the very same type is destroyed in sympathy. Kings are never harmed.

rows.name: Ancient Grove
rows.effect: Old roots give one piece back: return a captured rook, knight, or bishop to an empty square on your back rank; it returns after your opponent's next move, once.

rows.name: Arc Lightning
rows.effect: One rook arcs lightning along a diagonal, removing up to two enemy pieces in its path (never a king) and landing beyond them. The bolt then jumps to freeze the nearest surviving enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Backdraft
rows.effect: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, every enemy piece other than a pawn or king on the squares around it is destroyed.

rows.name: Bramble Wall
rows.effect: Thorns snare the clergy: your opponent's bishops cannot move or capture for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Creeping Roots
rows.effect: Roots grip at the border: your opponent's pawns cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Flame Lance
rows.effect: One of your rooks breathes a lance of flame straight up its own file, without moving: the first enemy piece in the jet, if it is not a king, burns away. Friendly pieces block the flame, once.

rows.name: Glaciate
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece (never a king) for 3 of their turns, and the frost spreads: all but one of the enemy pieces directly beside it (up, down, left, or right) are frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Hailstorm
rows.effect: After your opponent replies, freeze every one of their pawns for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Lightning Bolt
rows.effect: One queen charges a bolt down a diagonal; after your opponent's next move it fires, removing the first enemy piece in its path (never a king) and landing beyond it, once.

rows.name: River Flow
rows.effect: The board runs like water: for your next 2 turns your rooks may each slip through one friendly piece in their way.

rows.name: Stone Soldiers
rows.effect: Up to four of your pieces (never your king) are carved into stone soldiers: each cannot move and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns, then the stone crumbles and they wake.

rows.name: Undertow
rows.effect: A current sweeps one of your pieces to any empty square, then drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward where it lands.

rows.name: Wheel of Fortune
rows.effect: Spin for one of six random effects: plus 55 seconds to your clock, minus 55 from theirs, your army uncapturable for their next 2 turns, a new knight in your half, every enemy piece asleep for 2 turns, or two random enemy pieces removed.

rows.name: Bayonet Charge
rows.effect: One of your bishops charges diagonally, capturing the first enemy piece in its path and landing just beyond, once.

rows.name: Command Tent
rows.effect: Your king may also leap like a knight to an empty square, without capturing, for the game.

rows.name: Defectors
rows.effect: Mark one enemy pawn or knight: after your opponent's next move it turns to your side for the rest of the game, once. Kings cannot be swayed.

rows.name: Field Fortification
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, your pawns may also capture the enemy piece directly ahead of them, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Flanking Knights
rows.effect: Both of your knights may also step one square in any direction like a king, without capturing, for the game.

rows.name: Forward Observer
rows.effect: The observer calls in indirect fire: for your next turn, your rooks may capture an enemy piece along a rank or file even when exactly one piece stands in the way. The blocker is unharmed; the rook lands on its target.

rows.name: Last Reserves
rows.effect: Commit everything: pick empty squares on your back rank; after your opponent's next move, up to two of your captured knights or bishops return to them, once.

rows.name: Sapper Team
rows.effect: The sappers surface behind their lines: place a new pawn on an empty square in your opponent's half of the board.

rows.name: Spearhead
rows.effect: One of your rooks drives in a straight line, capturing the first enemy piece in its path and stopping. The squares it punches through stay barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Suppressive Fire
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, every one of their knights is pinned down for their next 2 turns, and so is every enemy pawn standing directly beside one.

rows.name: Wyvern's Dive
rows.effect: A wyvern folds its wings and dives: one of your knights streaks in a straight line, snatches the first enemy piece it reaches, and lands just beyond, once.

rows.name: Apotheosis
rows.effect: Raise one of your knights, bishops, or rooks to godhood: it leaves the board for a higher plane, and a queen joins your pocket to descend in its place on a later turn. In exchange, you skip your next draft.

rows.name: Army of the Dead
rows.effect: The fallen answer the roll: one pawn musters into your pocket for every two of your pieces captured so far, plus one more, up to five in all. Drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Army Reversal
rows.effect: For your next 2 turns, each of your pawns may also move one square straight backward onto an empty square (no capture).

rows.name: Bee Swarm Simulator
rows.effect: Choose 3 empty squares on the two centre ranks. After your opponent's next move, one of your pawns appears on each square still empty.

rows.name: Bombombini Gusini
rows.effect: The bomber-goose lobs a stun grenade on a square: every enemy piece except a king in the 5 by 5 area centred on it (that square and the 24 around it) is bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Nobody is removed.

rows.name: Buff Thief
rows.effect: Steal one active buff of any tier from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Cavalry Charge
rows.effect: Charge a knight along a rank or file: it smashes the first two enemy pieces it hits, never kings, then rolls to the far side of them, stopping before the next piece or the edge. Its landing shock shoves every enemy a knight's leap away one square back.

rows.name: Checkmate Immunity
rows.effect: The first time your king is checked it is briefly warded, but the ward is now one opponent turn shorter: it only blocks capture when your own move left the king in check, once.

rows.name: Chimpanzini Bananini
rows.effect: The banana-monkey goes ape: for the game every one of your knights may also slide diagonally up to two squares, keeping its knight leap on top. It gains no rook movement.

rows.name: Clone Army
rows.effect: Four photocopier flashes in a row: four new pawns land in your pocket, ready to drop onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Comet Shard
rows.effect: A shard of a passing comet crashes onto the board as a bishop: place it on any empty square in your half. It lands still glowing, and its light also shields up to three other pieces you choose: those four cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Gotham's THE ROOK!!
rows.effect: Pick one of your rooks. For your next 2 turns it moves like a queen, and every capture it makes gains you 10 seconds.

rows.name: Loot Box
rows.effect: Crack the crate and pray to the drop table. Legendary, the rarest, grants a random apex card. Epic grants a bishop and 30 seconds. Rare grants a knight. Common grants a pawn. Almost one in three is a mimic that bites off your weakest piece.

rows.name: Danielle
rows.effect: Sunshine: grow three new pawns on any empty squares in your own half, basking in a warmth that keeps each of them uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Double Queen
rows.effect: Choose any one of your pawns, even mid-board; after your opponent's next move it promotes to a queen, unless it has moved or been lost.

rows.name: Dryad Grove
rows.effect: The grove parts for the clergy just once: your bishops may slide through one of your own pawns (never capturing it) to the square beyond. This is a single passage, spent the first turn any such slide is on offer, whether or not you take it.

rows.name: Duelist
rows.effect: Choose one piece; after your opponent's next move it survives the first capture against it and that attacker dies instead, once (kings excluded).

rows.name: Expansion Permit
rows.effect: The construction crew bolts a ninth file onto the board: for your next 3 turns your rooks and queens may slide off one side of the board and back on the other.

rows.name: Extra Move (Repeat)
rows.effect: Take two moves in a row on your next full turn. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Fault Line
rows.effect: Split the board; enemy pieces cannot cross one file you pick, for 2 turns.

rows.name: Phoenix Feather
rows.effect: One of your captured knights, bishops or rooks returns to the board on an empty square in your half. Knights first, then bishops, then rooks.

rows.name: Fur Elise
rows.effect: Run your fingers down the keys. Choose a bishop and glide it along one diagonal, sweeping away up to 3 enemy pieces in its path as it lands. Using it spends your next unused draft reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Geometry Dash
rows.effect: One of your pieces hits the beat: it dashes straight forward, phasing over your own pieces and smashing up to 2 enemies in its lane before landing. Never kings.

rows.name: Ghost Legion
rows.effect: All your pawns may jump over a blocker one square ahead, landing two ahead where empty, for 2 turns. The jump is use-it-or-lose-it: the first turn a jump is available but you move otherwise, Ghost Legion ends.

rows.name: Blood Wager
rows.effect: Lay one of your knights or bishops on the dais: 55% it rises as a rook, 35% it is taken, 10% the blood god is DELIGHTED: a rook, plus a pawn steps out of the mist beside it.

rows.name: Gossamer Veil
rows.effect: A shimmering veil of spider-silk tangles every long blade: your pieces cannot be captured by enemy bishops, rooks, or queens for your opponent's next 2 turns. Pawns, knights, and kings still cut through.

rows.name: Great Wall
rows.effect: One full rank you pick is impassable to enemies for 3 turns, but any enemy piece already standing on that rank is left free to move off it.

rows.name: Greenhouse
rows.effect: Raise a glass dome over one file. For the game, your pawns may promote one rank early, on your 7th rank instead of your 8th, when they advance along that file, capture out of it, or capture into it.

rows.name: Haerin
rows.effect: Cat's pounce: choose one of your pieces, then an enemy a knight's leap away. Snatch that piece off the board, land yours on its square, and it stands shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next turn, unless landing there gives check.

rows.name: Hanni
rows.effect: Spotlight: choose an enemy piece. It and every enemy piece within two squares of it are charmed and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings shrug it off.

rows.name: Hero's Journey
rows.effect: The call to adventure rings out: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, and your bank offer improves by one tier.
rows.action: keep: three cards plus bank improvement at T4; Algorithm Boost differentiated with a reroll

rows.name: Horn of Summoning
rows.effect: One long note wakes the stone itself: for the rest of the game, your rooks may also step one square diagonally.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Hyein
rows.effect: Long legs: for the game each of your pawns may also stride straight forward to the first or second empty square ahead, springing over anything in between.

rows.name: I Love Chaewon
rows.effect: Fearless choreography: gracefully reposition up to 3 of your pieces, gliding each to any empty square in your own half of the board.

rows.name: Ironclad
rows.effect: Every piece on your back two ranks, your king aside, cannot be captured for 2 turns.

rows.name: La Vaca Saturno Saturnita
rows.effect: The ringed cow swings into orbit: place a new knight on any empty square along the board's outer rim. While it settles it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, but this orbit shelter burns out early once the new knight has captured twice.

rows.name: Last Meal
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns your king may capture any enemy piece other than a king up to two squares away, leaping over anything in between. The first time your king moves, whether it feasts or comes up empty, the meal is over.

rows.name: Mass Promote Minor
rows.effect: Two pawns on your 4th rank or beyond become knights instantly. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Mind Dominion
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy rook or bishop for the game.

rows.name: Mind Empire
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy piece of any type below queen. Your control ends the moment that piece makes a capture, and it returns to your opponent.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Minji
rows.effect: Leader's guard: every one of your pieces standing within two squares of your king links arms and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns, but the guard drops the instant two of the protected pieces have captured.

rows.name: Mirror of Souls
rows.effect: You hold the glass between two reflections: name one of your pieces and an enemy piece of the same kind. After your opponent's next move, they trade places. Kings cast no reflection.

rows.name: Mortgage
rows.effect: Take out a loan against your home: summon a rook on any empty square. Freshly built, the rook cannot capture until after your opponent has replied. The bank keeps the deed, so you can never castle again for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Necromancer
rows.effect: Raise your strongest fallen piece as a spectre on an empty square in your half. It fights for you, then crumbles to dust after 5 of your turns. If nothing of yours has been captured, nothing rises.

rows.name: Algorithm Boost
rows.effect: The algorithm optimizes your feed: your next draft offers three cards, you gain a draft reroll, and you gain 15 seconds.
rows.action: REBALANCED: adds a draft reroll; Hero's Journey (three cards plus bank improvement, lower tier) no longer strictly dominates

rows.name: Archmage's Sabbatical
rows.effect: For 4 of your turns, instead of a normal move you may teleport one of your pieces (king excluded) to any empty square in your half.

rows.name: Blood Moon
rows.effect: For your next 3 moves, any capture you make lets you immediately move again.

rows.name: Coliseum
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces and an enemy piece of equal or greater value (kings excluded): both are removed, and you gain 10 seconds per point of value difference.

rows.name: Deja Vu
rows.effect: You take one extra move right away, and the enemy piece that moved last (king excluded) is stuck in the loop and cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Duplicate Glitch
rows.effect: Dupe glitch: gain a second copy of a random unspent card you hold. If your hand is empty, gain 2 draft rerolls instead.

rows.name: Emergency Patch
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, one randomly chosen enemy slider type (bishop, rook or queen) is limited to moves of 2 squares that turn.

rows.name: Fireworks Barge
rows.effect: Choose a 2x2 area: at the end of your opponent's next turn the rockets go off. Enemy pawns inside are destroyed; every other piece inside except kings is pushed one square outward if the square is free.

rows.name: Fourth Wall Repair Crew
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns, every enemy piece you capture is carried off-screen by the crew, gaining you 4 seconds each.

rows.name: Ghost Ship
rows.effect: A ghost ship sails a chosen file from your back rank, one square per your turn for 6 turns, passing through everything: any enemy piece except a king on the square it crosses is frozen for 1 turn. One of your pieces may take a free step as it sails.

rows.name: Lantern Festival
rows.effect: Revive up to 4 of your captured pawns onto empty squares of your second rank as lantern wisps. Any still on the board after 6 of your turns drift away.

rows.name: Mod Powers
rows.effect: Mute up to 3 enemy pieces (king excluded): they cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Nesting Doll
rows.effect: For 10 of your turns your royal line nests: when your queen is captured, a rook appears on an empty square beside her fall; when that rook falls, a bishop; when that bishop falls, a pawn. The first nested piece to appear skips your next draft.

rows.name: Off-Broadway Queen
rows.effect: Choose one of your pawns: it promotes to a queen the moment it stands on your 6th rank. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Pied Piper
rows.effect: Choose a file: up to two enemy pawns on it are lured one square toward you, onto empty squares, most advanced first.

rows.name: Player Trade
rows.effect: After your opponent replies, swap the squares of two of your chosen pieces. Kings sit out, and a pawn may not land on the first or last rank.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Promotion Jubilee
rows.effect: For 5 of your turns, the first of your pawns to step or capture onto the seventh rank may promote there, but only to a rook, bishop, or knight. That one early promotion ends the jubilee.

rows.name: Puppet Practice
rows.effect: Once: move an enemy bishop or rook yourself, along its normal lines, onto an empty square. No captures.

rows.name: Rolling Boulder
rows.effect: Roll a boulder down a chosen file from your side: the first enemy pawn in its path is flattened, the next piece beyond (kings excluded) is shoved one square onward, and the crater cannot be entered by your opponent for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Speedhack
rows.effect: Each of your next 5 moves puts 6 seconds back on your clock.

rows.name: Squire's Ascension
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, one of your pawns is knighted, permanently becoming a knight. If it ever captures a queen, it is crowned a queen.

rows.name: Tornado
rows.effect: A funnel travels a chosen file: every piece within one file of it (kings excluded) is flung to a random empty square in its own half.

rows.name: Upper Shelf
rows.effect: Your next draft is dealt from one tier higher. If it goes unused, the lift expires after two of your drafts.
rows.action: keep: tier-up axis vs Algorithm Boost's card-count axis

rows.name: Winter Palace
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any enemy piece except the king that ends its move on your back two ranks is frozen in ice for 1 turn.

rows.name: World Serpent
rows.effect: For 4 of your turns the serpent bites its tail: your rooks' and queen's horizontal moves wrap around the board edge.

rows.name: Overclocked
rows.effect: Crank the clock speed: add 75 seconds to your own clock. Then everything runs hot and has to cool down, so for your next 3 turns all your pieces can move only one square.

rows.name: Overrun
rows.effect: Your pawns can capture straight ahead on your next turn.

rows.name: Overtime Pay
rows.effect: You clock in and cash out on the spot: 105 seconds go straight onto your own clock the moment you play this. Time and a half, paid in full.

rows.name: Pay to Win
rows.effect: Money buys more of whatever is working: choose one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, and a store-bought copy of it joins your pocket, ready to drop onto an empty square on a later turn. The bill comes due at the shop: you skip your next draft.

rows.name: Phase Army
rows.effect: Your bishops, rooks, and queen pass through one friendly piece per move for 1 turn.

rows.name: Pop-up Ad
rows.effect: An ad nobody can close appears on the board: place a knight on any empty square. It is finally dismissed after 4 of your turns.

rows.name: Promote Now
rows.effect: Choose one of your pawns on your 6th rank or beyond; it promotes to a queen after your opponent's next move, once.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Purge
rows.effect: Remove one enemy piece below queen rank from the board.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Queen's Echo
rows.effect: Your rooks move like queens for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Rampart
rows.effect: Place a pawn on each of three empty squares you choose in your half; those pawns cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns, but the shield ends early once two of the protected pawns have made a capture.

rows.name: Reinforcements
rows.effect: Two pawns march in from the depot right now: place them on empty squares of your back two ranks.

rows.name: Rent-a-Rook
rows.effect: A rook arrives on loan: place it on an empty square in your half. It cannot be captured while on loan, but that loaner protection lapses once it has made two captures, and it drives off after 5 of your turns.

rows.name: Resurrect
rows.effect: Bring back your strongest captured piece to your half, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Resurrect Major
rows.effect: Revive a captured rook or bishop to any empty square, once.

rows.name: Riddle Game
rows.effect: You wager the deck itself on a dangerous game: your opponent's next two drafts are skipped, but so is your own next one.
rows.action: keep: draft-denial family T5 (skip 2, gated by combo tags)

rows.name: The Round Table
rows.effect: One sworn knight answers your call and waits in your pocket: spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Second Wind Major
rows.effect: Return a captured rook to any empty back-rank square, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Sever
rows.effect: Permanently disable one enemy buff and block its retrigger.

rows.name: Shatter
rows.effect: Choose one enemy rook, bishop, or knight; after your opponent's next move it shatters into a walnut for the rest of the game (it can only shuffle one square at a time), unless it has moved or been lost.

rows.name: Smurf Account
rows.effect: A suspiciously strong new player joins your side mid-game: choose an empty square in your half, and a fresh rook drops in there right after your opponent's next move, so it cannot capture before they reply.

rows.name: Spirit Guide
rows.effect: A patient spirit settles into one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it may also step one square in any direction, and it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Staff of Stasis
rows.effect: Bind the staff to one of your pieces: whoever dares capture it is locked in a bubble of frozen time for 3 of their turns. The ward lasts the rest of the game.

rows.name: Starfall
rows.effect: A rook crashes down into your pocket: drop it onto any empty square on a later turn.

rows.name: Stone Golem
rows.effect: Bind a spirit into rock and stone: a lumbering golem serves as a rook for 5 of your turns, then crumbles back to rubble.

rows.name: Supply Drop
rows.effect: A knight is airlifted into your reserves, and a crate of spares lands with it as a pawn, arriving only after your opponent's next move. Later, spend turns to drop them onto empty squares.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Uniqlo Warrior
rows.effect: Suit up in the daily fit. Choose up to four of your pieces: they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: The Void Realm
rows.effect: Three squares you pick become voids for your opponent's next three turns: any enemy piece except a king that lands directly on one is swallowed. Pieces beside a void are safe.

rows.name: Border Ward
rows.effect: A warded frontier: for their next 2 turns your opponent may not move any piece into your half of the board, unless the move captures.

rows.name: Conjured Rook
rows.effect: Conjure a spectral rook into your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square. It stays as long as you do.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Disjunction
rows.effect: The conjuration is disjoined: up to two pieces waiting in your opponent's pocket wink out of existence, strongest first.

rows.name: Disrupt Ritual
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is skipped, and your next draft offer shows three cards instead of two.

rows.name: Sabotage
rows.effect: Saboteurs in their war room: your opponent's next draft is skipped, and their reroll token is stolen away if they still hold one.

rows.name: Spelltheft
rows.effect: A trade, technically: steal any one of your opponent's unused buffs, but the spell demands payment: your own lowest-tier unused card goes to them in exchange. Casting it also spends one of your draft rerolls, if you have any.
rows.action: keep: steal family T5 variant with payment rider

rows.name: Stolen Hours
rows.effect: Steal 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and take one extra move this turn. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move.

rows.name: Twin Familiars
rows.effect: A familiar perches on each of your bishops: for the rest of the game your bishops may also step one square straight (up, down, or sideways) but never to capture, finally changing their color.

rows.name: Unmake
rows.effect: The next capture your opponent makes is unmade: their piece snaps back to the square it came from, and your captured piece is restored where it stood. Kings cannot be unmade.

rows.name: Attack Goose
rows.effect: An attack goose invades your opponent's half as a knight for 2 of your turns, then honks off.

rows.name: Berserk Pawn
rows.effect: One of your pawns flies into a frenzy: for your next 3 turns it also moves like a queen, then it burns out and is removed from the board.

rows.name: Butterfingers
rows.effect: Your whole army is slathered in butter: enemy pawns and knights cannot capture your pieces for their next 2 turns. Nothing short-armed can keep a grip.

rows.name: Confetti Cannon
rows.effect: Your next capture goes off like a confetti cannon: every enemy piece other than a king within one square of the captured square is blown off the board.

rows.name: Conga Line
rows.effect: The whole line dances one step to the side: every one of your pawns shifts one square toward the board edge you pick, onto an empty square only, never a capture (pawns with no room sit the song out).

rows.name: Deal with the Devil
rows.effect: Sign here: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but the devil collects and you skip your next 2 turns, and the signing burns your next unused draft reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Hot Seat
rows.effect: The spotlight swings to their king and queen: on your opponent's next turn they may move only their king or their queen, and neither of them may capture.

rows.name: Musical Chairs
rows.effect: The music stops: swap the squares of one of your pieces and one of your opponent's pieces, once. Neither may be a king.

rows.name: Repo Rook
rows.effect: A repo man's rook rolls up behind enemy lines: place it on an empty square in your opponent's half, and it tows itself away after 3 of your turns.

rows.name: Rubber Duck Squad
rows.effect: Your bishops are secretly rubber: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece that captures one of your bishops bounces straight back to the square it came from. Rigging the bounce burns your next unused draft reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Ball Lightning
rows.effect: Your next 2 captures each also destroy the enemy pieces (never a king) on the two squares immediately left and right of the captured square.

rows.name: Firestorm
rows.effect: After your opponent replies, a firestorm falls on the crossroads: every enemy piece except a king standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) is consumed.

rows.name: Frostbite
rows.effect: Your opponent's pieces go numb: for their next turn they cannot make any capture, and no piece may move more than 2 squares.

rows.name: Mountain Range
rows.effect: Three peaks heave up out of the board: pick three empty squares; your opponent's pieces can never move onto them, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Overgrowth
rows.effect: Choose one of your pawns; after your opponent replies it blooms into a queen for your next 3 turns, then withers back into a pawn.

rows.name: Petrify the Ranks
rows.effect: Every enemy knight and bishop turns to stone: they cannot move for their next 2 turns. The card is spent even if your opponent has no knights or bishops to petrify.

rows.name: Stoneskin
rows.effect: Choose up to four of your pieces: they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, and every enemy piece standing next to one of them is locked in place for its next turn.

rows.name: Thunderhead
rows.effect: A charged cloud takes shape as a knight on an empty square in your half, and its arrival blasts one enemy pawn standing beside it off the board. It fights for 3 of your turns, then rolls away.

rows.name: White Monster
rows.effect: Crack the can: take 2 extra moves right now for a triple-move turn. Zero sugar means zero crash. Once.
rows.action: REBALANCED: crash removed (2 extra moves, no self-skip); was strictly worse than Sugar Rush at the same tier

rows.name: Bombardment
rows.effect: Remove two enemy pawns you name from the board, once.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Claymore Line
rows.effect: Mark two empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto either one, a king aside, is destroyed along with every enemy piece on the squares around it. The mines stay armed for the game.

rows.name: Demolition Charge
rows.effect: Rig one of your pieces with charges: each of its next two captures also destroys the enemy's least valuable piece standing next to the capture square (ties break toward the lower square). Kings are never caught in the blast.

rows.name: Form Square
rows.effect: Pick any square: your pieces standing on it or any of the up-to-eight squares around it, your king aside, cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: High Ground
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces: for the game it cannot be captured while it stands in your opponent's half, but its shield drops on any turn it is giving check to the enemy king.

rows.name: Mass Defection
rows.effect: Mark two enemy pawns: after your opponent's next move they turn to your side for the rest of the game, once.

rows.name: Muster the Ranks
rows.effect: The trumpet sounds and the whole line steps off: every one of your pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square. Pawns one step from the last rank hold their ground.

rows.name: Outriders
rows.effect: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, then up to two different pawns each advance one square behind it.
rows.action: REBALANCED: escorts up to two different pawns forward, separating it from Summon Knight (T3)

rows.name: Paratroopers
rows.effect: Mark two empty squares in your opponent's half, once. After your opponent's next move a new pawn drops onto each square that is still empty: they dig in where they land, and neither can be captured for 1 full turn.

rows.name: Recommission
rows.effect: Return one of your captured rooks to an empty square on your back rank. For the rest of the game the refitted rook may pass through one friendly piece on each move, landing only on an empty square (it cannot capture on a phased move).

rows.name: Relentless Assault
rows.effect: Each of your next two capturing moves immediately grants you an extra move. You cannot capture the king on a bonus move: your opponent replies first. Once both bonus moves are spent, you skip your next draft.

rows.name: Zodiac Wheel
rows.effect: You read all twelve houses at once: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, all fated to tier 4.

rows.name: Abyss
rows.effect: Two squares you pick open an abyss for the game: any enemy piece except a king that enters is swallowed. The defender keeps one bridge, the void nearest the enemy king, which never swallows.

rows.name: Amazon Knight
rows.effect: One knight becomes a knight plus queen for 2 turns.

rows.name: Annihilate
rows.effect: Remove one enemy piece below the queen, and freeze every enemy piece orthogonally beside it for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Ascendant Knight
rows.effect: One knight moves as an amazon for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Atomic Reaction
rows.effect: Your next two captures each detonate: the two enemy pieces immediately left and right of the captured square, kings aside, are removed. The blast never chains.

rows.name: Bayview Secondary School
rows.effect: Detention for the whole class. Choose a square: after your opponent's next move, every enemy piece except the king in the 3 by 3 around it is locked in place for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: 225 Bench
rows.effect: Press 225 and shove up to 3 enemy pieces one square back toward their own home rank. Blocked pieces stay put, nobody is captured.

rows.name: Blitzkrieg
rows.effect: Take one bonus move now, then one more stored bonus move on your next turn after your opponent replies. You cannot capture the king during a bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Blood Pact
rows.effect: Sign in blood: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but another pawn of yours, you choose which, bursts and is lost.

rows.name: Cataclysm
rows.effect: Clear all but one of the enemy pawns on the board.

rows.name: Chain Lightning
rows.effect: One bishop captures up to three enemy pieces down a diagonal and lands beyond them; the bolt then jumps on to freeze the next enemy piece further along that diagonal for 2 of their turns, once.

rows.name: Chaos Theory
