rows.effect: A tornado sweeps the board: every pawn, yours and your opponent's, is randomly reshuffled among the squares pawns currently stand on. Happens once.

rows.name: Check Out Our Socials
rows.effect: Go live to the squad. Freeze up to 3 enemy pieces except the king for their next turn, then take one bonus move.

rows.name: Collapse
rows.effect: Pull every enemy piece except the king one square toward their back rank across the whole board, once.

rows.name: Colossus
rows.effect: One piece becomes uncapturable and gains queen movement for 3 turns, but while it is shielded it cannot give check.

rows.name: The Death Arcana
rows.effect: The thirteenth card turns face up and names its mark: choose one enemy piece except a king. It is doomed: after 3 of their turns it dies, wherever it has run to. Only being captured first spares it the mark.

rows.name: Detonation Field
rows.effect: Your next three captures each remove at most one adjacent enemy piece: the most valuable non-king beside the captured square, kings aside. The blast never chains.

rows.name: Divine Intervention
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to strike at your king in that time is hurled clean off the board. Kings are never banished.

rows.name: Divine Mandate
rows.effect: You speak with the authority of heaven: one enemy knight, bishop, or rook joins your army, and heaven shields the defection so it cannot be recaptured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Kings cannot be swayed.

rows.name: Double Amazon
rows.effect: Choose two knights; each may make one queen-style move once, then moves as a normal knight again.

rows.name: Draft Domination
rows.effect: Force your opponent's next draft down to tier 2, so both cards they are offered come from a weak tier.

rows.name: Draft Seize
rows.effect: Take both cards in your next draft and skip your opponent's next, though they gain a reroll in return.
rows.action: keep: take-both plus opponent skip at T6, distinct axis (denial)

rows.name: Endless Turn
rows.effect: Take exactly one bonus move. If that bonus move does not capture, take one more bonus move after your opponent replies.

rows.name: Favorable Stars
rows.effect: You cast your chart and the houses agree: your next draft is fated to offer tier 6 cards.
rows.action: REBALANCED: forces tier 6 (was tier 5, strictly dominated by High Roll T4 forcing the same tier)

rows.name: Fissure
rows.effect: Split one file you pick: enemy pieces cannot cross it for your opponent's next 2 turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Dragonblood
rows.effect: For your next 4 turns your queen may also leap like a knight.

rows.name: Full Planche
rows.effect: Lock one of your pieces into a perfect hold. It slides like a rook along every open rank and file for the game, and hovers uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns, until the moment it makes a capture, which ends the immunity early.

rows.name: Full Rewind
rows.effect: Send up to five of your pieces back to their original home squares, once.

rows.name: Giant's Maul
rows.effect: The maul comes down once: crush one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and the shock leaves every enemy piece beside it (kings aside) frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Glass Cannon
rows.effect: Choose a bishop. Once your opponent replies, for your next 4 turns it can capture any enemy except the king along its diagonals, passing through anything in between. But while it is overcharged, if it is captured, two of your pawns shatter with it.

rows.name: Martingale
rows.effect: Flip until you miss, half odds each flip, ladder capped at four. One win pays a pawn, two pays two pawns, three a knight and a pawn, four a rook and a knight. You keep the rung you reached.

rows.name: Progressive Jackpot
rows.effect: For 6 of your turns every capture by either side drops a soul in the pot. When time is called, whoever made the LAST capture summons the pot: 2 souls a pawn, 4 a knight, 6 or more a rook, placed in their half. No captures, no winner.

rows.name: The House
rows.effect: For 6 of your turns you ARE the house: every draft either player resolves pays you a chip. Cash out automatically: 2 chips buy a reroll, 4 chips a fresh pawn on your second rank.

rows.name: God-King
rows.effect: Your king walks between heartbeats: it may also leap like a knight to an empty square, for the rest of the game. The leap cannot capture.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Grand Retreat
rows.effect: Return your army to its free starting squares, once (blocked pieces stay put).

rows.name: Grand Summon
rows.effect: Add a knight and a bishop to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns; your next draft is skipped.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Gravity Well
rows.effect: Your king bends space around it: enemy pieces standing within one square of your king are caught in orbit and cannot move to a square farther from it. Enemy kings are not affected.

rows.name: Griffon Rider
rows.effect: Move up to two of your pieces to any empty squares, once.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Guardian Angel
rows.effect: Twice per game, when your opponent captures one of your pieces (not your king), it is spirited to safety instead: an identical piece reappears on an empty square deep in your half. It cannot move, so cannot capture, until your opponent replies.

rows.name: Home Field
rows.effect: Home advantage: while standing in your own half of the board or one rank past it, each of your knights, bishops, and rooks may also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: I Love NewJeans
rows.effect: Harmony: for the game, every non-king piece of yours that stands next to a friendly piece may also step one square in any direction onto an empty square, but this step cannot capture.

rows.name: I Love Making Out
rows.effect: Bond two of your pieces for the game. Each also moves the way the other does, blending a knight with a bishop or a rook with a queen, but these borrowed moves cannot capture.

rows.name: Jackpot
rows.effect: Pull the lever for a one-in-two shot at a random apex card, one of the game's most powerful. Miss, and the consolation is still rich: your next draft rolls one tier higher and offers three cards instead of two.

rows.name: Lich Phylactery
rows.effect: The first time your queen is captured, a new queen appears on her home square, or on the nearest empty square of your back rank if her home is taken.

rows.name: Lightning Strike
rows.effect: Mark up to three enemy knights, bishops, or pawns; after your opponent's next move, lightning falls and removes each marked piece that still stands.

rows.name: Loyal Pawn
rows.effect: Once, a pawn stepping onto your 7th rank may promote there instead of the 8th. The new piece cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Minefield
rows.effect: Seed three mines on empty squares. The first enemy piece, never a king, to step on each mine is destroyed, and the blast removes every enemy piece except kings on the 8 squares around it. Shielded pieces resist the blast.

rows.name: Nova
rows.effect: Sacrifice one pawn to clear every enemy piece except the king from its file, once.

rows.name: Onslaught
rows.effect: The whole army surges: for your next 3 turns, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: Cloud Serpent
rows.effect: A serpent coils a chosen rank: enemy pieces cannot enter or cross it for your opponent's next 5 turns (yours can). As it lands it may crush one enemy pawn on an adjacent rank.

rows.name: Colossal Visitor
rows.effect: A colossal lizard crosses a chosen file: every pawn on it is trampled, every other piece (kings excluded) is shoved one file aside where empty, and two random empty squares of the file smolder: your opponent cannot enter them for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Democracy
rows.effect: Parliament sits for 3 of your turns. After each of your moves the house votes: usually applause worth 8 seconds, sometimes a motion that marches a random pawn of yours forward, occasionally a filibuster where nothing happens at all.

rows.name: Frost Wyrm
rows.effect: An ice dragon sweeps a chosen rank: every enemy piece on it (king excluded) is frozen for 2 turns, and its empty squares become ice walls your opponent cannot enter for their next turn.

rows.name: Grail Quest
rows.effect: Send one of your knights away on quest. After 5 of your turns it returns to a random empty square in your half as a Grail Knight, permanently able to also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: Grand Illusionist
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot capture your knights or bishops, and using it spends one of your unused draft rerolls if you have any. Which one was the real one again?

rows.name: The Great Flood
rows.effect: A wave washes every piece on the central four ranks (kings excluded) one square toward its own back rank, where that square is empty. Blocked pieces stay.

rows.name: Heavenly Bureaucracy
rows.effect: Once within your next 8 turns: when an enemy move puts your king in check, the check is misfiled and your king is relocated to a random empty square that is not attacked. If no safe square exists, the filing stands.

rows.name: High Water Mark
rows.effect: The middle two ranks flood: for your opponent's next 3 turns their bishops, rooks and queens cannot move through them, only into them.

rows.name: Hostile Takeover
rows.effect: Spend your turn issuing the order: name one enemy piece (not their king) and any square it could legally reach without capturing. After your opponent's next move it is reassigned there, if the piece still stands and the square is still empty.

rows.name: Locust Swarm
rows.effect: Choose a rank: every pawn on it, yours and theirs, is devoured.

rows.name: Meteor Golf
rows.effect: Tee off at any square, in plain sight of both players. Until it lands, the target and its adjacent squares are sealed against your opponent. After their next move the meteor strikes: any piece on the target, kings excluded, is destroyed and the seal lifts.

rows.name: NerfChess: The Musical
rows.effect: The whole board takes the stage, once: rearrange up to five of your pieces onto empty squares in your half, then collect 10 seconds for putting on a show.

rows.name: Puppeteer's Gala
rows.effect: Pull the strings: move up to two different enemy minor pieces yourself, each along its own normal non-capture moves, onto empty squares.

rows.name: Royal Food Taster
rows.effect: Place a Taster pawn on an empty square next to your queen. The next time your queen is captured, the Taster dies in her place and your queen returns on the Taster's square.

rows.name: Standing Ovation
rows.effect: An audience gathers for 5 of your turns: each of your moves that leaves the enemy king under attack earns 10 seconds of applause.

rows.name: The Tutorial
rows.effect: A relentlessly cheerful tutorial haunts your opponent for their next 3 turns: every enemy move is marked and reviewed, and whenever their moved piece ends up hanging you are paid 8 seconds while it congratulates them.

rows.name: Volcanic Vent
rows.effect: Open a vent on an empty square for 9 of your turns. Every 3rd of your turns it erupts: pawns of both sides adjacent to it are destroyed, and other adjacent pieces except kings are pushed one square outward if the square is free.

rows.name: Overwhelm
rows.effect: Take two moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king during these bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Promotion Storm
rows.effect: All pawns on your 5th rank or beyond promote to knights.

rows.name: Purge Realm
rows.effect: Remove every enemy minor piece from one half of the board.

rows.name: Purge Storm
rows.effect: Remove three enemy pawns and freeze the rest for 1 turn.

rows.name: Queen's Wrath
rows.effect: In one move, your queen slides along one straight line to an empty square without capturing, then freezes every enemy piece beside her landing square for their next turn; the line stops at the first piece of either color, once.

rows.name: RGB Keyboard
rows.effect: Light up every key. For the game your knights add a 1-square step any direction, your bishops slide 2 straight, and your rooks slide 2 diagonally, but these added moves cannot capture.

rows.name: Rift Storm
rows.effect: Teleport up to two of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, then swap the squares of two enemy pieces caught in the churn, once.

rows.name: Royal Ascension
rows.effect: Your king gains queen movement permanently, but its added long-range moves cannot capture; it still captures as a normal king (and still loses on capture).

rows.name: Second King
rows.effect: Choose one of your pawns, on any rank; after your opponent's next move it becomes a second king. Your opponent must capture both of your kings to win.

rows.name: Sinkhole
rows.effect: The earth chooses where to open: three sinkholes appear on random empty squares in your opponent's half. Any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one plunges out of the game. They stay open the rest of the match.

rows.name: Sundering
rows.effect: Choose three files: each is barred to your opponent until the end of their next turn, then collapses.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Time Lock
rows.effect: Lock your opponent's clock and hand: they skip their next turn, and their next draft is skipped, once.

rows.name: Time Skip
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn, and the piece they last moved is frozen for their next 2 turns. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Time Stop (Short)
rows.effect: Time stops: freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 turn, then take one extra move right now, once. You cannot capture the king during the bonus move: your opponent replies first. Afterward your next draft is skipped.

rows.name: Total Nullify
rows.effect: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in piece upgrades resist. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
rows.effect: The drum-man marches on your opponent's king. On each of your next 5 turns, the two enemy pieces nearest their king are bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

rows.name: Union Rules
rows.effect: Your pieces get mandated rest: for your opponent's next 2 turns after they capture one of your pieces, they cannot make a capture. If capturing is their only legal option, the rule is waived for that turn.

rows.name: Unseelie Bargain
rows.effect: Free action: strike a bargain with the dark court and take two extra moves right now. When the sequence resolves the price comes due and you skip your next draft.

rows.name: Valkyrie
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any knight, bishop, or rook of yours they capture is carried home to your pocket instead of being lost for good. Drop it back onto an empty square on a later turn. In exchange, you skip your next draft.

rows.name: Void
rows.effect: The void takes one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop, and the square it stood on stays a void that swallows any enemy piece except a king that enters it, for the game; the defender gets one bridge, so the first enemy piece to enter crosses it safely.

rows.name: Frozen Moment
rows.effect: Seal this moment in glass: choose one enemy piece except a king. After 3 of their turns, wherever it has run to, it is snapped back to the square it stands on right now (if that square is free again).

rows.name: Leaden Crown
rows.effect: Turn one of your pawns into a queen, and the leaden crown guards it: that new queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Royal Aegis
rows.effect: Your king and your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Warp Cataclysm

rows.name: Clown Car
rows.effect: Two knights pile out of one tiny car: place them on two empty squares that touch each other. Both are too dizzy to move on your next turn.

rows.name: Concrete Shoes
rows.effect: Fit one of your opponent's rooks or queens with concrete shoes: it cannot move at all for their next 3 turns, then it hardens into a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Wrecking Ball
rows.effect: Your queen winds up a full swing: after your opponent's next move, every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her is smashed off the board. Shielded pieces resist the swing, once.

rows.name: Conflagration
rows.effect: Remove two enemy pieces, each a pawn, knight, or bishop, once.

rows.name: Flash Freeze
rows.effect: After your opponent replies, freeze every enemy piece standing next to your king for their next 2 turns and bonk it where it stands.

rows.name: Flood
rows.effect: Three floodwaters spread over empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto one with a non-capturing move (never a king) is swept off the board. A piece that captures its way onto the water is not swept. They stay for 2 of your turns.

rows.name: Frost Ward
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Every enemy piece that ends a move next to your king in that time is frozen for 1 turn and bonked where it stands.

rows.name: Glacier Wall
rows.effect: Two walls of ice rise: pick any two squares, and every empty square on each of their files becomes impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns. Any enemy piece already standing on a frozen file may leave normally.

rows.name: Immolation
rows.effect: Offer one of your own pawns to the flame: it is consumed, and the blast removes up to seven enemy pieces (never kings) on the 8 squares around it. If all eight squares hold enemies, one is spared. Shielded pieces resist the fire.

rows.name: Quagmire
rows.effect: Open two patches of sucking mud on empty squares: any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one is stuck fast for its next 3 turns instead of removed. The mud stays for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Rooted
rows.effect: Roots seize the heavy pieces: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Scorch

rows.name: Thorn Barrier

rows.name: Werewolf

rows.name: Armored Breakthrough

rows.name: Bridgehead
rows.effect: Place a new knight on an empty square in your half and a new pawn on an empty square on your fourth rank or lower, once.

rows.name: Combined Arms
rows.effect: Armor learns from cavalry: for your next 3 turns, your rooks may also leap like knights.

rows.name: Counter Battery Fire
rows.effect: Remove one enemy rook or bishop you name from the board, once.

rows.name: Double Trench
rows.effect: Pick two files: your opponent cannot move onto either file for their next 2 turns, and any enemy piece standing on those files cannot capture in that time. Committing the trench spends the card even if it catches nothing.

rows.name: Forward Outpost
rows.effect: Place a new rook on any empty square in your own half, once.

rows.name: Mercenary Queen
rows.effect: Hire a sellsword who fights as a queen for 3 of your turns, then rides off with her pay.

rows.name: Pincer Movement
rows.effect: Close both jaws at once: every enemy piece except a king caught directly between two of your pieces (left and right, above and below, or across a diagonal) is pinned and frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Praetorian Guard
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it cannot be captured and may also step one square in any direction like a king.

rows.name: Shieldbearers
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, while at least one of your pawns stands on a square beside your king, your king cannot be captured, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Aegis of the Ages

rows.name: Amazon

rows.name: Amazon Army
rows.effect: For your next three turns your knights also move as bishops and your bishops also move as knights. Neither becomes a full amazon.

rows.name: Ban Hammer
rows.effect: Moderator privileges activated: point at one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and up to two enemy pieces of that type are permanently banned from the board.

rows.name: Brr Brr Patapim
rows.effect: The cold finds whoever wanders alone: every enemy piece except the king with no friendly piece on any square beside it freezes solid for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Buff Siphon
rows.effect: Steal two active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

rows.name: Cappuccino Assassino
rows.effect: The espresso assassin strikes before the foam settles: the enemy piece nearest your king (never their king) is destroyed, and the two enemy pieces nearest the scene of the crime are stunned for their next turn.

rows.name: Celestial Ascension
rows.effect: Your bishops ascend to a higher plane: for the game every one of them also moves in straight lines like a rook, wielding a queen's full reach.

rows.name: Chain Atomic
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns, whenever a capture involves one of your pieces the capturing piece is destroyed, along with up to one enemy piece beside it, kings aside. No chains.

rows.name: Cramling Family Night

rows.name: Deep Freeze

rows.name: Divine Legion

rows.name: Dragon's Breath

rows.name: Dragonslayer
rows.effect: The old blade remembers its work: name one enemy rook or queen and it is slain where it stands. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

rows.name: Fingertip Maltese
rows.effect: Elite fingertip hold on one enemy piece: it freezes for their next 3 turns and the empty squares around it are sealed, so no fresh piece can move in to rescue it, though pieces already beside it may leave normally.

rows.name: Sunforge
rows.effect: Choose one of your pawns on your 5th rank or beyond. It becomes a knight where it stands.

rows.name: Genesis

rows.name: Break the Bank
rows.effect: Three laser grids, 60% each to slip through. Three clean: your best captured piece returns AND a random tier 6 card joins your hand. Two: the tier 6 card. One: a pawn, and a random piece of yours is jailed 2 turns. Zero: two pieces jailed 2 turns.

rows.name: God Knight
rows.effect: One knight becomes an amazon (queen plus knight), for the game.

rows.name: Golden Touch
rows.effect: The next two enemy pieces you capture (other than kings) are reforged as your own and added to your army on empty squares in your half. The price of greed: each reforging turns one of your pawns to gold, and it is lost.

rows.name: Grand Nullify
rows.effect: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in upgrades resist. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Grand Resurrection
rows.effect: Revive your queen to your half.

rows.name: Great Divide
rows.effect: One full rank you pick becomes impassable to enemies for your opponent's next 2 turns. Pieces already standing on that rank may still leave it.

rows.name: I Love Cami

rows.name: I Love My Sister
rows.effect: Bring your strongest fallen piece home to an empty square in your half. She arrives shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns, but the shield ends once she has made two captures.

rows.name: Joseph Leung
rows.effect: Sign the board. Bind one of your pieces: for the game it moves as a knight and queen at once, and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Judgment Day

rows.name: King's Legion

rows.name: Meteor

rows.effect: Two 2x2 areas (neither containing a king, away from the back ranks) trade their entire contents, square for square. Then one of your pieces that moved may take a free king-step to an empty adjacent square, without capturing.

rows.name: Symphony of the Legion
rows.effect: Three movements, each a free action, at most one per your turn, in order: first every pawn you own advances a square; second each of your knights and bishops drifts one random empty step; third your rooks and queen may pass through friendly pieces this turn.

rows.name: Phoenix Line
rows.effect: Revive all your captured pawns to your 2nd rank, once.

rows.name: Purge Line
rows.effect: Remove every enemy piece below queen rank on one rank you pick.

rows.name: Queen's Rampage
rows.effect: In one move, your queen sweeps along one straight line you choose and removes every enemy piece on it; a friendly piece or an enemy king ends the line, once.

rows.name: Resurrect Queen
rows.effect: Bring your captured queen back to any empty square on the board, and she cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Roost of Rocs
rows.effect: Three titanic rocs descend and perch along the board's edge: place three knights on empty squares of the outer rim, then skip your next draft.

rows.name: Roulette
rows.effect: Spin the wheel three times: three random enemy pieces other than the king are removed from the board.

rows.name: Ruin
rows.effect: Clear all enemy pawns, and destroy one enemy minor piece (or a rook if they have no minor).

rows.name: Soul Harvest
rows.effect: Your queen sweeps one diagonal, reaping every enemy piece she passes and landing on an empty square beyond them, never on a capture; for each piece reaped, a friendly pawn rises on an empty square in your half, plus one bonus pawn, once.

rows.name: Total Warp
rows.effect: Teleport your whole army except the king anywhere you like, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

rows.name: Triple Amazon
rows.effect: Up to three of your knights move as amazons for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Twin Queens
rows.effect: Promote two pawns to queens instantly if both are on your 5th rank or beyond. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

rows.name: Grand Dominion

rows.effect: Your next draft offer, you take both cards instead of choosing one.

rows.name: Genie Wish

rows.name: Whiteout
rows.effect: A blizzard freezes every enemy piece except the king and pawns for their next turn. The pawns can still trudge.

rows.name: The Wild Hunt
rows.effect: The horns of the twilight court sound: pick any square, and the Hunt rides both diagonals through it, carrying off every enemy piece on them. Kings are never taken.

rows.name: Dug-In Defense

rows.name: Annihilation
rows.effect: Remove any two enemy pieces below the queen from the board.

rows.effect: For your next 3 turns, all your pieces except your king also move like a queen. For the 2 turns after that, all your pieces can move only one square.

rows.effect: Paint a square, then the payload drops after your opponent's next move: up to four enemy pieces except kings in the 5 by 5 area centred on it are destroyed, the four nearest the centre first. Anything that flees the area before it lands is spared.

rows.name: Buff Plunder
rows.effect: Steal two active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

rows.name: Cataclysmic Meteor
rows.effect: Pick a 3x3 area. Remove up to three enemy pieces in it, kings aside. If more than three are present the least valuable are destroyed, so the defender keeps their strongest.

rows.name: Celestial Alignment
rows.effect: The stars chart the light squares and hold everything found there: every enemy piece except the king standing on a light square is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Danya's Speedrun
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns they may only play a capture, a check, or a pawn move. Each held turn pays you more time: 2 seconds, then 3, then 4, and so on.

rows.name: Divine Fortress

rows.name: Divine Right
rows.effect: For your next 5 turns your king may move and capture as a queen, and it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Draft Supremacy

rows.name: Mild Sting

rows.action: keep: flat 2-turn capture ban T3; White Flag Hour redesigned onto a rolling cadence

rows.name: Returned to Sender
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is skipped, but their following draft offers three cards instead of two, plus one free reroll.

rows.name: Durian
rows.effect: Lob the king of fruits onto an empty square: for your opponent's next 3 turns no enemy piece may move onto a square next to it. The first piece caught by the stench still gets one step into the ring; after that the ring is sealed until the stench clears.

rows.name: Brambleroot
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks cannot move sideways along a rank for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Frostbite
rows.effect: Target one enemy piece, kings excluded. The frost bites after your opponent's next move, following the piece if they move it, then freezes it for 3 of their turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Gargoyles
rows.effect: Petrify one of your opponent's bishops for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Cursed Dice
rows.effect: Your opponent rolls the bone dice. 40%: one random enemy piece is cursed to freeze for a turn, but gets one free move to escape first and freezes wherever that leaves it. 35%: a random enemy pawn stumbles back a square. 25%: the dice grin and nothing happens.

rows.name: Gorgon's Glance
rows.effect: Turn one enemy knight or bishop you target into a walnut: 2 of their turns if it stands in its own half, 4 if it was caught in yours, where the gaze is strongest.

rows.name: Hard Reset
rows.effect: Your opponent's most advanced pawn reboots to its starting square. If that square is taken, the pawn freezes for 1 turn instead.

rows.name: Hobbled Cavalry
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, their knights turn to walnuts for their following 2 turns: a walnut can only shuffle one square at a time.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: No Reins
rows.effect: Their next move keeps its footing, then for their following 4 turns every bishop, rook or queen slide must run as far as the line allows: to the edge, into a capture, or up against one of their own pieces. Knights, pawns and the king are unaffected.

rows.name: Tolling Bell
rows.effect: Starting with your opponent's next turn and on every second turn after (their 1st, 3rd and 5th), the toll deafens their long arms: bishops, rooks and queen cannot move on tolling turns. It fades after their 5th turn.

rows.name: War Rations
rows.effect: Their next move is free, then across your opponent's following 5 turns they may make at most 2 captures. Once both are spent, their army cannot capture at all until the curse ends.

rows.name: Blood Bond
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever one of two bound enemy pieces captures anything, the other is frozen for 2 of their turns. The very first capture by either is free. Trade either away and the bond is cut. Kings cannot be bound.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Jammed Portcullis
rows.effect: For the next 10 of their turns, if your opponent castles the portcullis jams behind them. Two of their turns later the rook that castled may make one last move to relocate, then it grinds to a halt and is frozen for 3 of their turns. Kings are never frozen.

rows.name: No Retreat
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, none of their pieces may move toward their own back rank: no retreating, no sidestepping backward. They may advance or move straight across. The king is exempt, and a piece with no forward move is freed for that turn.

rows.name: Slow Poison
rows.effect: Poison one enemy queen, rook or bishop. In 4 of their turns it withers a full rank: queen to rook, rook to bishop, bishop to knight. One capture is the antidote: if the poisoned piece takes anything before then, the poison is purged.

rows.name: Wandering Sentry
rows.effect: A spectral sentry paces a rank in your opponent's half for 4 of their turns: the square it stands on is barred to their pieces, and every turn it steps one file across, turning back when it reaches the edge.

rows.name: Ash Veil
rows.effect: A veil of ash hides your minor pieces: your opponent cannot capture your knights or bishops for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Borrowed Crown
rows.effect: One of your opponent's pawns, chosen at random, finds a crown and gets ideas: it is gilded for 6 of their turns and, weighed down by delusion, becomes a walnut for 1.

rows.name: Bramble Patch
rows.effect: Choose 2 empty squares: brambles cover them for 2 of your opponent's turns, and none of their pieces may stop there.

rows.name: The Burned Keep
rows.effect: Your opponent may not castle, and both of their rooks, busy fighting the fire, are frozen for 1 of their turns. The ban has no time limit and holds until they make a capture, which douses the flames.

rows.name: Carrion Crows
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs that captures inside your half of the board is mobbed by crows and frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Clay Hooves
rows.effect: Every enemy knight that has left its starting square hardens into clay and is frozen for 2 of their turns. Knights still at home are spared.

rows.name: Cold Reception
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any pawn of theirs that enters your half of the board is frozen for 1 of their turns on arrival. The first pawn to cross slips through unfrozen; every pawn after it freezes.

rows.name: Cold Shoulder
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their king may not end a move adjacent to any of your pieces.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Court Gossip
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 2 turns, none of their pieces may end a move adjacent to your queen: everyone is terrified of being mentioned.

rows.name: Cracked Bell
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, the truce bell rings on their 2nd and 4th turns: on those turns they cannot capture.

rows.name: Crooked Arrow
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns, their rooks may only move an odd number of squares: 1, 3, 5 or 7.
rows.action: REDESIGNED: odd distances, 4 turns; even distances duplicated Gremlins

rows.name: Crown of Lead
rows.effect: Their king is crowned with lead and wears the dunce cap for 9 of their turns. Under its weight, for their next 3 turns no piece standing adjacent to their king may capture.

rows.name: Donkey Ears
rows.effect: Their king sprouts magnificent donkey ears (the dunce cap, worn for 6 of their turns), and the shame stings: for their next 2 turns their king cannot capture anything.

rows.name: Drawn Curtain
rows.effect: Choose one rank. Your opponent's next move passes freely; then, for their following turn, none of their pieces may stop on it or cross it. Your pieces pass freely.

rows.name: Falling Rubble
rows.effect: Collapse a 2x2 block of squares you choose: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on any of those 4 squares for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Fear of Open Ground
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their rooks may not stop on a file that holds no pawns of either color. Open ground makes them itch.

rows.name: Frost Heave
rows.effect: The ground in your half buckles with frost: every enemy pawn currently standing in your half of the board, except the first, is frozen for 2 of their turns. One pawn shakes free.

rows.name: Gale Warning
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move on an edge square is pinned flat and frozen for 1 of their turns. The first piece the gale would pin keeps its footing. Kings keep their footing.

rows.name: Gargoyle Perch
rows.effect: Up to two enemy rooks you target turn into walnuts for 1 of their turns: they can only shuffle one square at a time.
rows.action: REDESIGNED: perches on up to two rooks; single-rook walnut was dominated by Stone Curse

rows.name: Groom's Leash
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may only land on squares adjacent to another of their own pieces. Stray leaps are forbidden. The first stray leap slips through once, then the leash binds fully.

rows.name: Guild Insurance
rows.effect: Your rooks are insured by the masons' guild: your opponent cannot capture them for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Haunted Gallery
rows.effect: Ghosts walk the great dark diagonal (a1 to h8): every enemy piece standing on it is frozen in dread for 1 of their turns. Their king is spared.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Hearth Frost
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, frost creeps into their barracks: every enemy pawn still standing on its owner's second rank is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Heavy Dew
rows.effect: A freezing dew settles at dawn: every enemy piece standing on its owner's fourth rank is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Hobble Strap
rows.effect: Buckle a hobble onto one enemy piece (never the king): starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns it may move at most 1 square at a time.

rows.name: Hollow Fanfare
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 7 turns, any pawn they promote arrives as a walnut for 2 of their turns: crowned, celebrated, and unable to do more than shuffle.

rows.name: Hundred Year Nap
rows.effect: Put one enemy piece you target into an enchanted sleep: it is frozen for 3 of their turns, but it thaws at once if any of your pieces comes to attack it. Kings cannot be enchanted.

rows.name: The Iron Ring
rows.effect: An iron ring closes around the board's rim: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on any edge square for their next turn.

rows.name: Jam on the Row
rows.effect: Pick any square: starting after your opponent's next move, every enemy piece then on that rank (never the king) is stuck in spilled jam and frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Know Your Place
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their knights and bishops may not capture rooks or queens. The first such capture slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Rank has its privileges.

rows.name: Loyal Hound
rows.effect: A spectral hound sits directly in front of their king (on the square toward your side) and follows him for 3 of your opponent's turns: they cannot stop on that square. The first piece to try slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

rows.name: Narcolepsy
rows.effect: Two of your opponent's pieces, chosen at random (never the king), fall asleep mid campaign and are frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: No Sidling
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, purely horizontal moves are forbidden: every move must change rank. The first horizontal move slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Plumed Helmets
rows.effect: Their knights are issued enormous ceremonial wings for 5 of their turns, and preening takes time: their knights cannot move on their next turn.

rows.name: Restless Blades
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their swords demand rhythm: if their previous move was quiet and a capture is available, they must capture.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: River Watch
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their rooks may not cross the midline into your half of the board. The first rook the ferry would stop may cross once, then it binds fully.

rows.name: Rope Bridge
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, pieces may cross the midline into your half only on the central files (c to f). The first piece to cross elsewhere slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. The flanks have no bridge.

rows.name: Rusted Battlements
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, both of their rooks seize with rust and cannot move for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Rusty Visor
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns, their visors stick shut: no piece may capture an enemy piece more valuable than itself. Capturing the king is always allowed.

rows.name: Severed Lines
rows.effect: Their supply roads are cut: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on their own 3rd or 4th rank for their next turn.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Shifting Floor
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns, none of their pieces may end a move on the rank your king stands on. The floor there will not hold them. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Skittish Mounts
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their knights may not land adjacent to any of your pieces. The horses smell trouble.

rows.name: Soft Shells
rows.effect: Two of your opponent's pawns, chosen at random, molt into walnuts for 2 of their turns: one square shuffles only. The first affected pawn gets one legal escape move before it molts.

rows.name: Soggy Invaders
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their pieces standing in your half of the board cannot capture. Wet powder, wetter morale.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Soot Fall
rows.effect: Soot blankets both long diagonals: for your opponent's next 2 turns, their bishops may not stop on any square of the a1 to h8 or h1 to a8 diagonals.

rows.name: Stunned Grief
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns, grief slows their revenge: after you capture one of their pieces, they may not recapture on that square on their very next turn.

rows.name: Tar Flood
rows.effect: Tar floods your opponent's third rank: for their next 2 turns, none of their pieces may stop anywhere on it. The first piece the tar would stop may cross once, then it binds fully.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: The Ides
rows.effect: A dreadful date circled on their calendar: on your opponent's 4th turn from now, whichever piece they move is frozen for 1 of their turns immediately after. Kings shrug off omens.

rows.name: Undertow
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs that moves backward, toward its own back rank, is frozen for 1 of their turns on arrival. Kings never freeze.

rows.name: Wagon Ruts
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, their rooks may only move along files, never sideways along ranks.

rows.name: Widow's Veil
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, their queen cannot capture anything. She is in deep mourning.
rows.action: REBALANCED: 6 turns of mourning; was identical to Butterfingers (T1)

rows.name: Winded Destrier
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any knight of theirs that captures must catch its breath and is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Wrong Map
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may only land on dark squares. The first knight to try a light square slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Someone printed the map inverted.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Leaden Crown
rows.effect: The crown is too heavy to march: after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns their queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Sideways and homeward slides are free.

rows.name: No Trespass
rows.effect: A truce holds at the crossroads: after your opponent's next move, they cannot capture anything standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) for their following 5 turns.

rows.name: Petrified Towers
rows.effect: Turn one enemy rook you target into a walnut for 1 of their turns, and while the tower stands petrified your opponent cannot castle at all.

rows.name: Rubber Chicken
rows.effect: Bonk one enemy piece with a rubber chicken. It gets one escape move; wherever it lands it is then dazed and can only shuffle one square at a time for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be bonked.

rows.name: Rusted Hinges
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks cannot capture for their next 4 turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Seized Axles
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks cannot move sideways for their next 4 turns: they may only slide up and down their own file.

rows.name: Sown Salt
rows.effect: Your opponent's pawns are rooted in salted ground for their next 2 turns and cannot move, not even to capture, except that the first pawn to move may take one escape move, after which every pawn is locked.

rows.name: Stinky
rows.effect: One enemy piece other than the king reeks: after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns their other pieces cannot move onto any square adjacent to it. The smelly piece itself may still move anywhere.

rows.name: Stone Curse
rows.effect: Target one enemy piece, not a king. It gets one unaffected move; then it turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, able only to shuffle one square at a time.
rows.action: keep: any-piece walnut 4 turns; Gargoyle Perch redesigned to two rooks

rows.name: Stone Hooves
rows.effect: Petrify one of your opponent's knights for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Trippi Troppi
rows.effect: The shrimp-cat scrambles their proprioception: mark up to 3 enemy pieces (never the king). After your opponent's next move they grow stubby shrimp legs, and for their next 2 turns each can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Understaffed
rows.effect: Half the office calls in sick. The first piece your opponent moves gets out freely; then for their next 2 turns they cannot move any piece standing on files a through d.

rows.name: Wasted Hour
rows.effect: The officers argue all morning: after your opponent's next move, on their following turn they may only move a pawn or their king.

rows.name: Backseat Driver
rows.effect: Someone will not stop yelling push a pawn: it takes a turn to sink in, so only after your opponent's next move, on the turn that follows, must they move a pawn if any pawn of theirs can legally move.

rows.name: Stage Fright
rows.effect: The next time your opponent's queen moves, she freezes where she lands for one of their turns. If that move gives check, stage fright hits harder and she becomes a walnut, shuffling one square at a time, for two of their turns instead.

rows.name: Abandoned Post
rows.effect: Nobody presses the attack: starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns any move toward your side of the board may cover at most 2 squares. Sideways moves and retreats keep their full range.

rows.name: Crown and Castle
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen and rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Cryostasis
rows.effect: Flash-freeze one enemy piece you target: it and every enemy piece beside it are frozen for 1 of their turns. The defender keeps their single most valuable caught piece free. Kings are never frozen.

rows.name: Daniel Caesar
rows.effect: Smooth things over. For your opponent's next 2 turns none of their pieces may capture anything, so the board stays calm while you set up.
rows.action: keep: full capture ban T4 baseline; No Easy Pickings now runs 4 turns on the honor-code axis

rows.name: Empty Handed
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is blocked and skipped.

rows.name: Faerie Ring
rows.effect: A ring of pale mushrooms springs up around a square you choose: the 8 squares surrounding it are impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Flypaper File
rows.effect: Coat one file in flypaper, visible to both players: for your next 6 turns, enemy pieces (kings excepted) that enter that file are stuck and cannot move for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Siren's Call
rows.effect: Choose an enemy knight, bishop, rook or queen. It stands entranced and cannot move for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Frozen Furrows
rows.effect: The ruts freeze over between hauls: for your opponent's next 5 turns, whenever they move a rook, their rooks cannot move at all on their following turn.

rows.name: Glacial Flanks
rows.effect: Freeze your opponent's knights and bishops for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Granite Towers
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, their rooks turn to walnuts for their following 3 turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.
rows.action: keep: rook walnut 3 turns T4 baseline; Castle of Sand now runs 4

rows.name: Gremlins
rows.effect: For their next 4 turns, your opponent's rooks can only move an even number of squares.
rows.action: keep: even-distance rooks T3; Crooked Arrow redesigned onto odd distances

rows.name: Heavy Shackles
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen and rooks are in irons for their next 2 turns. The first heavy piece they move slips free for that one move; after it, no queen or rook may move for the rest of the duration.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Hex Doll
rows.effect: You bind a lock of horsehair to a little cloth doll: choose one enemy piece except a king. If it captures anything within their next 2 turns, the pin goes in and it is destroyed.

rows.name: Hot Potato
rows.effect: Curse one enemy piece other than the king into a hot potato: after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns they must move that piece if it has any legal move.

rows.name: Compounding Misery
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece for 1 of their turns, plus 1 more turn for every other curse already afflicting your opponent (each frozen or petrified piece, sealed ground, or royal edict), up to 3 turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Curse of Recoil
rows.effect: Their weapons kick like cannons: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is flung straight back to the square it attacked from (the victim is still taken, but the ground is not). Captures that promote are too heavy to throw back.

rows.name: Twinned Torment
rows.effect: Their next move slips the fresh bond, then for their following 6 turns: whenever one of two bound enemy pieces moves, the other is frozen for 1 turn. A captured twin slips the bond and frees the other. Kings cannot be bound.

rows.name: The Witching Hour
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, every piece they move is touched by the hour. When midnight strikes at the end of those 3 turns, every touched piece freezes for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Aging Blade
rows.effect: It takes hold after your opponent's next move, then for their next 6 turns: whenever a queen, rook or bishop captures, it ages one rank on the spot. Queen to rook, rook to bishop, bishop to knight. Knights and pawns never age.

rows.name: Coronation Tax
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, each time they promote a pawn one of their other pieces is called to the ceremony and frozen for 2 of their turns. The new-crowned piece itself is untouched. Kings never attend.

rows.name: Debtor's Mark
rows.effect: Mark one enemy piece. For your opponent's next 6 turns, every turn they leave it idle it runs up one turn of debt, up to 4. The moment they move it the debt comes due: it is frozen for that many of their turns, then the slate clears. Kings keep no debts.

rows.name: Exile's Mark
rows.effect: Brand one enemy knight, bishop or rook: every move it makes must carry it closer to your side, and if it has not set foot in your half within 5 of their turns it crumbles to dust. The mark lifts the moment it stands in your half. Kings are never exiled.

rows.name: Hydra Hex
rows.effect: Brand one enemy piece as the hydra's head for the next 8 of their turns. If you cut it off, two heads grow back: the two enemy pieces nearest where it fell are each frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings are neither head nor spawn.

rows.name: Standing Guard
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, every time their king moves, whichever of their pieces stands nearest it is frozen for 1 of their turns. The first piece caught this way is spared and makes one move instead. The king itself is never frozen.

rows.name: Miasma
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, each time they move a piece so it ends adjacent to another of their pieces, it breathes in the miasma. On its third breath it is frozen for 2 of their turns and its lungs clear again. Kings do not sicken.

rows.name: Mutiny
rows.effect: It takes hold after your opponent's next move, then for their next 6 turns: the first time one of their knights captures a piece, it turns its coat on the spot and fights for you for your next 3 turns, then rides back to them.

rows.name: Forced Pilgrimage
rows.effect: Name a shrine square that one enemy piece must reach. If it stands on the shrine within 5 of their turns the geas lifts; if the deadline passes it collapses in exhaustion and is frozen for 3 of their turns. Kings take no geas.

rows.name: Sinking Mire
rows.effect: A mire of four squares opens in your opponent's half: no enemy piece may step onto it, though pieces caught inside may still climb out. It drains away one square on each of their turns until nothing is left, over 4 of their turns.

rows.name: Ashen Bread
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, killing the little ones curdles the stomach: any piece of theirs that captures one of your pawns is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Beartrap Cache
rows.effect: Hide traps on 2 empty squares you choose: the first enemy piece to stop on each is caught and frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings step over traps.

rows.name: Bell Jar
rows.effect: Drop a bell jar over one enemy piece you target: it and every enemy piece adjacent to it become walnuts for 1 of their turns, except the defender's most valuable piece under the jar, which is spared. Kings never fit under glass.

rows.name: Bounty Posted
rows.effect: Post a bounty for 5 of your opponent's turns: whenever YOU capture one of their pieces in that window, panic spreads and another of their pieces, chosen at random, is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Brittle Arsenal
rows.effect: Every enemy bishop, rook and queen turns to a walnut for 1 of their turns: the whole long range arsenal reduced to shuffling.

rows.name: Broken Compass
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, every move must end in a different quadrant of the board than it started in. The first piece to break the rule slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Broken Oars
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns, no move may travel in the same direction as their previous move. The crew cannot row the same stroke twice. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Burden of Command
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every time their queen moves, the whole army stops to salute: on their following turn they may move only their king. When the burden lifts, they bank one draft reroll.

rows.name: Candle Curfew
rows.effect: The candles are rationed, and everyone knows the schedule: on the 5th and 6th of your opponent's next 6 turns, they may only move a pawn or their king. The first piece the curfew would stop slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Censor's Ink
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns, the censor blacks out your latest position: they may not end a move on the file where your last moved piece stands. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Choke Point
rows.effect: Caltrops blanket the central 4x4 (c3 to f6): your opponent's pieces may not stop anywhere in it for their next turn. Their king picks its way through freely.

rows.name: Circling Vultures
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs with no friendly piece adjacent to it is watched too closely to fight: isolated pieces cannot capture.

rows.name: Coronation Bill
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, promotions come with an itemized invoice: the first pawn they promote costs them their following turn, skipped outright while they settle the bill.

rows.name: Cracked Lens
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their bishops cannot judge distance: they may only capture within 2 squares. The first bishop to reach further slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

rows.name: Creaking Gallows
rows.effect: The gallows creak for 2 of your opponent's turns, then the rope drops: their most advanced piece at that moment (never the king) is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Crime Scene
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns, every capture they make gets roped off: the square where the capture happened is sealed against them for 2 of their turns after the deed.

rows.name: Dead Man's Boots
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their pieces may not end a move on any square where a piece has been captured this game. The first piece to step onto a grave slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Doting Retinue
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, pieces standing adjacent to their queen may not move: the retinue will not leave her side. The queen herself moves freely.

rows.name: Famine Year
rows.effect: The harvest fails utterly: your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 5 turns. They may still capture diagonally.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Ferryman's Coin
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, crossing into your half costs the road home: when a piece of theirs crosses the midline, the square it left is sealed against them for 3 of their turns. The first piece to cross does so freely, then the toll holds.

rows.name: Feuding Towers
rows.effect: Their rooks are not speaking to each other: starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns a rook may not end a move on the same rank or file as another of their rooks.

rows.name: The Food Taster
rows.effect: Paranoia grips the throne: for your opponent's next 2 turns, their queen may not end a move on any square one of your pieces attacks.

rows.name: Fresh Crater
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, pieces standing adjacent to the piece you last moved cannot move: everyone is staring at the crater. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Frozen Harbor
rows.effect: The queenside harbor ices over: every enemy piece standing on files a, b or c is frozen for 1 of their turns, except the two most valuable, which resist the ice. Their king stays free.

rows.name: Gilded Cage
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their queen may only move to squares on their own back two ranks. The palace doors are locked from outside.

rows.name: Glass Ceiling
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, their pawns may not promote. The final step simply is not there.

rows.name: Iron Quota
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 6 turns the royal smithy only stocks battlements: any pawn they promote must become a rook.

rows.name: King's Ransom
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every time their king moves the ransom is collected: 2 of their other pieces, chosen at random, are frozen for 1 of their turns. The very first piece the ransom would seize slips free.

rows.name: Kraken Arms
rows.effect: Three tentacles burst from the board: choose 3 enemy pieces (never the king). The first you choose may make one move before the tentacle seizes it; each of the three is held fast, frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Lovestruck Majesty
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen falls head over heels: she may make one move, then is frozen, swooning, for 2 of their turns. Any other queens they have swoon at once.

rows.name: Mitred Blinders
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their bishops may slide at most 1 square.
rows.action: REBALANCED: at most 1 square; at most 2 duplicated Butter Bishops (T2)

rows.name: Moat Diggers
rows.effect: Your sappers dig 4 pits at random empty squares in your opponent's half. The defender keeps one as a bridge, the pit nearest their king; their pieces cannot stop on the other 3 for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Moth Plague
rows.effect: A plague of very judgemental pigeons descends: starting after your opponent's next move, 3 of their pieces, chosen at random (never the king), are dressed as pigeons for 6 of their turns and stunned for 1.

rows.name: Night Soil
rows.effect: The first rank of your half of the board is freshly manured: your opponent's pieces cannot stop anywhere on it for their next 2 turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: No Easy Pickings
rows.effect: A code of honor is imposed for your opponent's next 4 turns: they may only capture your pieces that are defended by another of your pieces. Undefended stragglers are off limits. The first forbidden capture slips through as one escape, then the code holds.
rows.action: REBALANCED: 4 turns; Daniel Caesar (full capture ban, 3 turns, same tier) no longer strictly dominates

rows.name: Oathbreaker's Brand
rows.effect: A brand hangs over their castle gate for their next 6 turns: if your opponent castles in that window, the castling rook is frozen for 3 of their turns and their king wears the dunce cap for 8.

rows.name: One Ladle Each
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, the mess line is strict: after any pawn move, their pawns cannot move on the following turn.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Overslept Officers
rows.effect: On your opponent's next turn, their knights and bishops cannot move. The officers overslept.

rows.name: Pawn Embargo
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, their pawns may not enter or move within your half of the board. The first pawn the border would stop may cross once, then it binds fully. The infantry is stopped at the border.

rows.name: Pawnbroker's Lien
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every pawn they move is seized as collateral: it is frozen for the remainder of the window.

rows.name: Poacher's Snare
rows.effect: A snare waits at the border: within your opponent's next 6 turns, the first piece of theirs to enter your half of the board is caught and frozen for 3 of their turns. Kings slip the noose.

rows.name: Rogue River
rows.effect: A river jumps its banks along one random file: starting after your opponent's next move, their pieces cannot stop anywhere on that file for their following 2 turns.

rows.name: Rusted Crown
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their queen may move only 1 square at a time, like a stiff old king.

rows.name: Sagging Shelves
rows.effect: Their undeveloped officers are shelved: starting after your opponent's next move, every enemy knight and bishop still standing on its own back rank is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Second Frost
rows.effect: The cold doubles down: starting after your opponent's next move, every freeze and every walnut then gripping your opponent's pieces lasts 1 of their turns longer.

rows.name: Silken Net
rows.effect: Cast a net over a square you choose: every enemy piece except the king within one square of it is frozen for 1 of their turns, save the strongest caught piece, which slips the mesh.

rows.name: Slack Bowstrings
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, the piece they moved on their previous turn is too winded to fight: it cannot capture this turn.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Smoke Line
rows.effect: Signal smoke streams from your king's tower: for your opponent's next 3 turns, none of their pieces may end a move on a diagonal your king stands on. The first piece to try slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Solstice Shadow
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, the solstice shadow falls on their king's square color: pieces of theirs standing on that color cannot capture.

rows.name: Stone Garden
rows.effect: All of your opponent's knights, bishops and rooks turn to walnuts for 1 of their turns, heavy nuts that can only shuffle one square at a time. Their two most valuable affected pieces resist and keep their footing.
rows.action: REDESIGNED: wider petrification (minors plus rooks) for 1 turn; minors-for-2 was dominated by Statue Garden

rows.name: Tangled Marionettes
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns the strings cross: they may not move any piece standing adjacent to the piece they moved last turn. That piece itself may move on. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Thistle Crown
rows.effect: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns, when your pieces give check only their king may answer: they cannot block the check or capture the checker with another piece. The king must move itself.

rows.name: Thunderhead
rows.effect: A storm gathers over their throne, in plain sight: after 1 of your opponent's turns, lightning falls and every piece adjacent to their king is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Tin Soldiers
rows.effect: Their knights and bishops are recast as toy soldiers: wooden for 5 of their turns, and stiff jointed for the first 2, during which they may move at most 2 squares.

rows.name: Traitor's Gala
rows.effect: Two of your opponent's knights or bishops, chosen at random, drink the wrong toast and become walnuts for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Understudy Rule
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, no two officer moves in a row: after moving a knight, bishop, rook or queen, their next move must be a pawn or king move. The first move blocked by this slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

rows.name: Velvet Rope
rows.effect: Your back rank is roped off: your opponent's pieces cannot stop anywhere on it for their next 3 turns. No entry, no promotion party.

rows.name: Wilted Garland
rows.effect: Their queen is crowned with a nesting doll shell for 6 of their turns, and the humiliation keeps her at arm's length: starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns she may not end a move within 2 squares of your king.

rows.name: Medusa's Stare
rows.effect: Turn one enemy queen you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Mute Button
rows.effect: You mute the loudest voices in their army: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks cannot capture. The first of those pieces they move gets one free move before the mute takes hold.
rows.action: keep: heavy-piece capture ban 3 turns T4 baseline; Banquet of Dust now runs 5

rows.name: Origami
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks are folded into paper cranes: they may move at most 1 square for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Patch Notes
rows.effect: The balance patch lands: your opponent's next draft is skipped. Once that draft has passed, you gain one draft reroll.

rows.name: Pawn Nerf
rows.effect: Nerf your opponent's pawns: their two-square double step is removed for the rest of the game. Every enemy pawn crawls one square at a time.

rows.name: Queen of Stone
rows.effect: The curse waits in her shoes: the next time your opponent moves their queen, she turns to a walnut for 3 of their turns the moment she lands.

rows.name: Royal Duty
rows.effect: On your opponent's next turn they may move only their king.
rows.action: keep: 1-turn king-only T3 baseline; Summons to Court now runs 2 turns

rows.name: Salted Earth
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns their pawns cannot advance; they may still capture diagonally. After that the salt lifts and their pawns advance normally again.

rows.name: Sealed Gate
rows.effect: Brick up one gate of your choosing: pick any square. The first enemy piece to step onto that square's file passes through freely; the instant it does, the whole file seals against your opponent for the remainder of their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Shackle the Queen
rows.effect: Bind the enemy queen in cursed iron: your opponent's next move slips free, then for the 4 of their turns after it they cannot move their queen.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Skill Issue
rows.effect: Diagnosis delivered: their minor pieces whiff every attack: enemy knights and bishops cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Spooked Steeds
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot move their knights for their next 2 turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Stone Clergy
rows.effect: Your opponent's bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time. The first bishop keeps one free move before it too sets.
rows.action: keep: bishop walnut mirror of Granite Towers' rook walnut

rows.name: Twist the Knife
rows.effect: Their drawback bites back: for your opponent's next 3 captures, the capturing piece is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Vertigo
rows.effect: The whole room tilts sideways: for their next turn your opponent may only make diagonal moves. Their king keeps its footing and may still step anywhere.
rows.action: keep: diagonal-only constraint at T4, different geometry

rows.name: Cast a Nerf
rows.effect: Cast a nerf on your opponent: they cannot capture for their next 2 turns, though the first piece caught by the curse may still make one capture. Their next drafted card arrives nullified.

rows.name: Curse of Frailty
rows.effect: A wasting curse saps the enemy's strength: their next move slips free, then for the 3 of their turns after it your opponent cannot capture, and no piece of theirs may slide more than two squares.

rows.name: Divine Reckoning
rows.effect: Choose an enemy piece, not the king. It is sent to a free starting square of its kind if any, may make one last move, then freezes for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Doom March
rows.effect: The march ends where it stands: after your opponent's next move, enemy pieces that have crossed into your half of the board are gripped by dread and cannot move, for the 4 of their turns after it.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Fissure Field
rows.effect: The ground splits open behind the enemy army: your opponent cannot move any piece onto their own back rank for their next 4 turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Gorgon Gaze
rows.effect: Every enemy knight and bishop turns to stone for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Frost Wall
rows.effect: A wall of blue ice seals the keep: your opponent cannot move any piece onto your back two ranks for their next 4 turns, save one bridge square left open for the defender, the wall square nearest their king.

rows.name: Frozen Moment
rows.effect: The next piece your opponent moves freezes solid the instant it lands and cannot move again for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Granite Ramparts
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and for their next 2 turns they cannot move any piece onto their own back two ranks.

rows.name: Hard Frost
rows.effect: Freeze two enemy pieces you target so they cannot move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Hexed Satchel
rows.effect: Your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified and does nothing, and in return they gain one draft reroll for a later offer.
rows.action: keep: nullification axis vs Paper Orders' offer-filtering axis

rows.name: Homesick
rows.effect: Your opponent's army is homesick: every piece may only move toward or along its own back rank for their next 4 turns. The first piece they move gets one free move before the pull sets in.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Creeping Blight
rows.effect: Blight one square in your opponent's half. Their next move may still cross it, then no enemy piece may move onto blighted ground, though pieces already there may leave. Each of their following turns it creeps to one more adjacent square, for 5 turns.

rows.name: Cursed Coin
rows.effect: The holder's first move slips free, then for the rest of your opponent's next 8 turns the holder cannot capture and moves at most 2 squares. Whenever the holder and another of their pieces end a move beside each other, the coin jumps. Kings never take it.

rows.name: Queen's Ransom
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, each time they move their queen, two other pieces of theirs are seized as surety and frozen for 1 turn. The queen herself is never restrained.

rows.name: Weight of Toil
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, any single piece that makes its third move in that time collapses under the toil and becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns, shuffling one square at a time. Kings never collapse.

rows.name: Bounty Mark
rows.effect: Paint a bounty on one enemy piece for the next 5 of their turns: whenever the marked piece captures anything, it is swarmed by bounty hunters and frozen for 2 of their turns afterward. Kings carry no bounty.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Collapsing Floor
rows.effect: Crack one rank in your opponent's half. It lies quiet until after their next move, then 3 of their turns later the floor gives way and every piece of theirs still standing on that rank is frozen for 2 of their turns. Their king is never trapped.

rows.name: Roaming Maw
rows.effect: A void opens in your opponent's half. Each of their turns it drifts one square toward their nearest piece, bars the square it holds, and swallows any piece it reaches, never the king. The central crossing deeper in their half stays safe. Hunts 6 turns.

rows.name: Shared Fate
rows.effect: Stitch two enemy pieces together for the next 8 of their turns: if you capture one, the other is doomed, with one escape. If they move it on their very next turn it slips free, otherwise it drops dead where it stands. A king can never be fate-bound.

rows.name: Wildfire Rot
rows.effect: Rot one enemy piece; it gets one move first. For your opponent's next 6 turns rotten pieces cannot capture, the rot spreads each of their turns to one more piece beside an infected one, and capturing a rotten piece burns that infection out. Kings never rot.

rows.name: Banquet of Dust
rows.effect: Their heavy pieces are seated at a feast of nothing: for your opponent's next 5 turns, their queen and rooks cannot capture.

rows.name: Castle of Sand
rows.effect: Both of your opponent's rooks crumble into walnuts for 4 of their turns: heavy husks that can only shuffle one square at a time. The first tower the sand would claim may make one move, then it too crumbles.

rows.name: Change of Step
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, each move they make must use a different piece type than their previous move. Their king is always allowed. The first move the drill would forbid slips through once, then the rule binds fully.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Court in Session
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any of their pieces standing adjacent to their own king may not move. The king itself is free to go.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Dead Letter
rows.effect: Your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified: they still pick it, but it does nothing.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Echo of Bells
rows.effect: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then, for their next 6 turns, every second turn (the 2nd, 4th and 6th) the bells toll and they may only move a pawn or their king.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Ford Crossing
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any move that crosses the midline into your half must stop on the first rank of your half; deeper landings are forbidden. Their king is exempt. The first piece the ford would stop may cross once, then it binds fully.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)
