rows.name: Grasping Ivy
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move adjacent to your king is seized by vines and frozen for 1 of their turns. The first piece to reach the court escapes the vines; every piece after it is seized.

rows.name: High Water
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their rooks and queen may not enter your half of the board. The first piece the flood would stop may cross once; after that it binds fully.

rows.name: Iron Portcullis
rows.effect: The armory gate slams shut: your opponent's next draft is skipped outright, and their following draft offers only two cards and cannot be rerolled.
rows.action: REBALANCED: skips 2 drafts; a single skip was dominated by Burned Dispatches (skip plus nullify, T5)

rows.name: Ironglass Mirror
rows.effect: Your threats harden into glass: for your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs standing on a square one of your pieces attacks cannot move. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Lantern Out
rows.effect: The lights go out at home: for your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot capture anything standing in their own half of the board.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Lead Rain
rows.effect: A rain of lead pins the field: 4 of your opponent's pieces, chosen at random (never the king), are frozen for 1 of their turns. Their single most valuable piece is immune and is never among them.

rows.name: Leaden Boots
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, none of their pieces may move more than 2 squares. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Lockstep
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, every move they make must cover exactly the same distance as the move you made just before it. Their king is exempt, and if nothing matches they move freely.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Night Ledger
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their rooks and queen answer to the accountants: they may only move if the move is a capture. Quiet heavy moves are struck from the ledger.

rows.name: Night Watch Rota
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their knights and bishops are on watch duty every other turn (the 1st and 3rd) and cannot move on those turns. The first knight or bishop the rota would bench slips through once, then it binds fully.

rows.name: No Homecoming
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, none of their pieces may stop on their own back rank. Their king is exempt. The first piece the ban would turn away may return home once, then it binds fully.

rows.name: No Quarter
rows.effect: Your half of the board rejects the invasion: every enemy piece currently standing in your half becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: No Return
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, the border runs one way: pieces of theirs standing in your half may not move back across the midline into their own half.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Paper Orders
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft offer excludes draft manipulation cards, and after that draft resolves you gain one reroll. The couriers were paid to lose that satchel.

rows.name: Quicksand Quarter
rows.effect: The queenside quarter of your half (files a to d) turns to quicksand: your opponent's pieces may not stop there for their next 3 turns. Pieces already standing in the quarter may still move freely. Their king is exempt.

rows.name: Royal Escort
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their queen may not end a move more than 2 squares from one of their rooks. If they have no rooks, she travels unguarded and freely. The first move the escort would forbid slips through once, then it binds fully.
rows.action: REDESIGNED: queen chained to her rooks (was king-anchored, a semantic duplicate of Throne Bound)

rows.name: Sandstorm
rows.effect: Grit chokes every sightline: for your opponent's next 3 turns, their bishops, rooks and queen may slide at most 3 squares. The first piece the storm would rein in may slide freely once, then it binds fully.

rows.name: Silk Cocoon
rows.effect: Wrap one enemy knight or bishop you target in silk: it is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Stone Rain
rows.effect: Petrifying hail sweeps their lines: 5 of your opponent's pieces, chosen at random (never the king), become walnuts for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Summons to Court
rows.effect: On your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king. The crown answers alone.
rows.action: REBALANCED: 2 king-only turns; 1 duplicated Royal Duty (T3)

rows.name: Tar Pits
rows.effect: Choose 3 empty squares: they become bubbling tar for 3 of your opponent's turns, and none of their pieces may stop on them. The first piece the tar would stop may wade through once, then it binds fully.

rows.name: The Bell Tolls
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn entirely. The board waits for no one, except them.

rows.name: Tidal Wall
rows.effect: Your opponent's pieces cannot stop on either central rank, the 4th and 5th, for their next 2 turns, save one bridge square left standing: the wall square nearest their king.

rows.name: Tithe of Blood
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is frozen for 1 of their turns immediately after the kill. The first piece to make a kill slips free; every capture after it freezes. Kings never freeze.

rows.name: The Toy Box
rows.effect: On your opponent's next turn, their non-knight pieces may move at most 1 square; their knights move normally.

rows.name: Tribute Demand
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every capture they make demands tribute: whichever of their other pieces stands nearest the kill is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Wall of Teeth
rows.effect: Your two back ranks grow a wall of teeth: for your opponent's next 3 turns their pieces cannot stop anywhere on them, though any piece already standing there may still move freely. No infiltration, no promotion.

rows.name: Waste Not
rows.effect: Thrift is enforced for your opponent's next 3 turns: when they capture, they must use the least valuable piece that can capture that turn. Quiet moves stay free.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Iron Furrow
rows.effect: The field is sown with iron spikes: your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns, and any enemy pawn that captures during that time is caught on the spikes, unable to move for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Lava Floor
rows.effect: Pick any square and its entire rank erupts, barred to your opponent for their next 4 turns, except one bridge square left open on the file of their king. The eruption throws every enemy piece on the barred squares one square back toward its home rank.

rows.name: Lone Sovereign
rows.effect: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king and their knights. Every other piece is stuck fast.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Lost Weekend
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn, and their clock loses 20 seconds.

rows.name: Medusa's Verdict
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, their queen turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and every enemy piece then standing next to her is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Opposite Day
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot move any piece closer to your king. Moves that keep the same distance are allowed. If that would leave them with no legal move, the restriction is lifted for that turn.

rows.name: Palsied Hands
rows.effect: Their hands shake after every kill: for your opponent's next 5 turns, they cannot capture on two turns in a row.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Peasant Levy
rows.effect: The levy defends only the homeland: for your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only pieces standing in their own half of the board. Anything already across the middle is stranded.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Puck's Mischief
rows.effect: A hobgoblin ties every royal shoelace together: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks may move only one square at a time.

rows.name: Queen's Handicap
rows.effect: Nerf your opponent's queen: for their next 3 turns her every move must end beside another of their own pieces. No escort, no move.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Scorched Middle
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot enter the 4th or 5th ranks for their next 3 turns, save one bridge: the square on their king's file, on whichever of the two ranks sits nearer their own side, stays passable.

rows.name: Statue Stable
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and your own knights harden into living statues: they cannot be captured for those same 2 turns.

rows.name: Stone Menagerie
rows.effect: Target two enemy minor pieces (knights or bishops). After your opponent's next move, both are petrified for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Throne Bound
rows.effect: The queen may not stray from her king: for your opponent's next 3 turns, her every move must end within 2 squares of their king.
rows.action: keep: king-anchored leash; Royal Escort now chains her to the rooks instead

rows.name: Jinx
rows.effect: The jinx sours every friendship: for their next 2 turns, your opponent's pieces cannot end a move on a square beside another of their own pieces.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Broken Elevator
rows.effect: The lift to your half is out of order: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto either of your two back ranks. The first piece turned away still gets to make that one move.

rows.name: Shy Pieces
rows.effect: Your opponent's pieces are too shy to approach the crown: for their next 2 turns none of them may move onto a square touching your king.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Wrong Way
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's pieces has its map upside down: after their next move, for the 2 turns that follow none of them may retreat toward their own back rank.

rows.name: Riptide
rows.effect: A countercurrent runs through the middle of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that ends its move on the 4th or 5th rank is dragged one square back toward its home rank, when that square is free.

rows.name: Withering Touch
rows.effect: One enemy piece freezes solid for 2 of their turns, then withers to a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Ball and Chain
rows.effect: Their drawback grows teeth: for your opponent's next 5 turns, the piece they just moved must rest a turn before moving again.

rows.name: Changeling
rows.effect: The cradle swap ran the other way: one enemy knight or bishop you choose was a changeling all along. The glamour breaks and it is just a pawn.

rows.name: Creeping Frost
rows.effect: Freeze three enemy pieces (not the king) for 2 of their owner's turns. The first piece you choose gets one escape move: its freeze sets in only after your opponent's next move.

rows.name: Eternal Statue
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for 6 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Everfrost Shard
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece you target for 4 of their turns. The shard radiates: for those 4 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto a square beside it. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Iron Maiden
rows.effect: Choose an enemy piece other than the king. It is locked in place for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Grounded Command
rows.effect: The heavy pieces are grounded: for your opponent's next 4 turns a queen or rook still in their own half cannot move onto any square in your half. One already standing in your half moves freely.

rows.name: Groundhog Day
rows.effect: Whichever piece your opponent moves on their next turn is caught in a loop. Their turn after that is one free escape, but on the turn after it they must move that same piece again. If that piece can no longer move, the loop is skipped.

rows.name: Beacon of Woe
rows.effect: Light a doom-beacon on one of your OWN pieces, in full view. When your opponent's 6th turn from now ends, every enemy knight, bishop, rook and queen is frozen for 2 of their turns. If they capture the beacon-bearer first, the curse dies with it.

rows.name: Chains of the Court
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights and bishops are petrified into walnuts for 4 of their turns, shuffling one square at a time. The chains have a lock: if their king steps onto one of the four centre squares, every petrified courtier is freed at once.

rows.name: Gathering Storm
rows.effect: Their next move is clear, then the storm worsens every two turns across their following 6. Turns 1-2: their pawns cannot advance, captures still fine. Turns 3-4: knights and bishops also cannot cross into your half. Turns 5-6: long pieces capped at 2 squares.

rows.name: Gilded Rot
rows.effect: Their next move passes untouched, then for their following 5 turns each piece they move is gilded, and a gilded piece cannot capture for the rest of the curse. When the curse ends the gold flakes off everything at once.

rows.name: Gravebloom
rows.effect: Their next move passes untouched, then for their following 6 turns every square where they capture becomes a grave-garden for 3 of their turns: the capturing piece may leave, but no enemy piece may move onto that square while it blooms.

rows.name: Pauper's Crown
rows.effect: Their queen becomes a rook for 4 of their turns, or until she captures. If she is taken while a rook, she is lost as a rook.

rows.name: Avalanche
rows.effect: Snow gathers over their half for 3 of their turns, then falls. For the 3 turns after, their pieces may only capture or move into your half, never onto an empty square at home. The first piece they move once it falls gets one escape onto open ground.

rows.name: Sleeper Cell
rows.effect: Plant a sleeper in one enemy knight or bishop. On their 3rd turn from now it wakes and defects: yours to command for your next 3 turns, then it slips back. Until it turns it is still theirs. Kings are never turned.

rows.name: Effigy of Dread
rows.effect: Raise a leering effigy on an empty square in your opponent's half. No enemy piece may step onto the ring around it, though a piece already inside may leave. It stands 6 of their turns, and it is a piece they can capture: smashing it ends the curse.

rows.name: The Inverted Crown
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn that reaches the last rank is crowned a mere knight, no matter what they choose to promote to.

rows.name: Powder Keg
rows.effect: Roll a powder keg onto an empty square in your opponent's half with a lit 4-turn fuse, in full view. When it blows, every enemy piece except the king standing on or next to that square is blown off the board, and you gain one draft reroll.

rows.name: Avalanche Pass
rows.effect: Snow buries both central files: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on the d or e file for their next 2 turns, while yours climb freely. Pieces already standing there may leave freely.

rows.name: Black Lotus
rows.effect: The lotus blooms once over their army: one random pawn, knight, bishop, rook and queen of theirs (one of each they still have) is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Chain Gang
rows.effect: On your opponent's next turn, every piece they own may move at most 1 square, except their single most valuable piece, which the chains spare. King captures are always allowed.

rows.name: Checkers Law
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, if any capture is available to them, they must play a capture. The old rules apply.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Dead Calm
rows.effect: The wind dies: for your opponent's next 2 turns, their bishops, rooks and queen may slide at most 1 square. The first piece the calm would rein in may slide freely once, then it binds fully.

rows.name: Dead March
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 6 turns, the drums forbid haste: on every second turn (the 2nd, 4th and 6th) their rooks and queen cannot move.

rows.name: Debt Collector
rows.effect: The collector holds off for one move, then watches for 5 of your opponent's turns: their second capture in that window makes the capturing piece a walnut for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Dockmaster's Fee
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every capture they make is taxed: on the turn after a capture they may only move a pawn or their king. The first piece the tax would hold back may make one move regardless, then it binds fully.

rows.name: Frozen Reserves
rows.effect: The reserves never got the mobilization order: every enemy piece standing on their own back rank, except pawns and the king, is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Gorgon's Court
rows.effect: Choose 2 enemy pieces (never the king): both become walnuts for 3 of their turns. The first piece chosen may make one move before it petrifies.

rows.name: Grave Chill
rows.effect: A chill rises from below: every enemy piece standing on a dark square is frozen for 1 of their turns. Their king shivers but stays free.

rows.name: Hall of Mirrors
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, every piece must land on a square of the same color it started from. Knights, whose every leap changes color, cannot move at all. Their king is exempt.

rows.name: Hunter's Moon
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is cursed by the moon and becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns. Kings are beyond the curse.

rows.name: Iron Maiden
rows.effect: Clamp one enemy rook or queen you target in iron. After your opponent's next move, it is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Ivory Tower
rows.effect: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then, for their next 4 turns, their king may not move toward your side of the board. Sideways and homeward steps are free.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: The Old Laws
rows.effect: The ancient rulebook is enforced: for your opponent's next 4 turns there is no castling, no two square pawn advance, and no en passant. The first piece the old law would forbid may make one such move, then it binds fully.

rows.name: Pied Piper
rows.effect: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then the pipe plays and the infantry follows: for their next 2 turns, if any pawn move is available they must move a pawn.

rows.name: Pillory
rows.effect: Lock one enemy piece you target in the pillory: it wears the dunce cap for 6 of their turns, and after it makes one move it is frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be locked up.

rows.name: Prowler's Bell
rows.effect: A bell is tied to every gate in your half: for your opponent's next 3 turns, their pieces may not end a move on an EMPTY square in your half. They may enter only by capturing. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Quagmire March
rows.effect: Your half of the board turns to bog: your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns, any piece of theirs standing in your half may move at most 1 square. Their king is exempt.

rows.name: Reaper's Due
rows.effect: The reaper collects from the front line: your opponent's 3 most advanced pieces (never the king) are frozen for 2 of their turns. The most advanced of them may make one move before it freezes.

rows.name: Sealed Meridian
rows.effect: Choose a file: for 2 of your opponent's turns none of their pieces may cross it, though they may move along it, stop on it, or leave it. Your pieces pass freely.

rows.name: Signal Jam
rows.effect: Your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns, none of their pieces may end a move on the same file as their own king. The king itself may move freely.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Siren Song
rows.effect: Mark one enemy piece: for your opponent's next 2 turns, every move it makes must bring it closer to your king. The rest of their army is free. Kings cannot be marked.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Sleepwalkers
rows.effect: Your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns, pieces that start a move in their own half cannot capture. Only their pieces already in your half may fight.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Spider's Parlor
rows.effect: Invisible webs stretch between the armies: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move adjacent to one of your pieces is snared and frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings tear free.

rows.name: The Walnut Crown
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns: the mightiest piece on the board reduced to a slow, dignified shuffle.

rows.name: Walnut Pinch
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen turns into a walnut for 1 of their turns: a heavy nut that can only shuffle one square.

rows.name: Wax Seal
rows.effect: Their supply lines are sealed: your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified, and their next offer excludes draft manipulation cards.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: White Flag Hour
rows.effect: A rolling truce is called: on the 1st and 3rd of your opponent's next 4 turns, they cannot capture anything.
rows.action: REDESIGNED: rolling truce (no captures on the 1st and 3rd of 4 turns); flat 2-turn ban duplicated Cream Pie

rows.name: Kraken
rows.effect: A kraken surfaces on an empty square. For your opponent's next 2 turns, at the end of each of their turns it drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward it when the square between is empty, then seizes any enemy piece beside it so it cannot move next turn.

rows.name: Leaden Fields
rows.effect: Their pawns are cast in lead: every advanced enemy pawn first sinks one square back toward home (if that square is free), and then their pawns cannot move at all, not even to capture, for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Lost Days
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn entirely. On the turn after that, they may move only pawns, knights, or their king.

rows.name: Lunar Eclipse
rows.effect: The moon slides into shadow and the enemy's great powers still with it: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for 3 of their turns, though the first of them may slip away with one move before the shadow takes it.

rows.name: Nerf Hammer
rows.effect: Bring down the nerf hammer: turn one enemy knight, bishop, or rook you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns. It can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Nerf This
rows.effect: The balance team finally answers: one enemy queen you point at is patched down to a bishop where she stands. The defender keeps one queen immune, so a lone queen shrugs the patch off.

rows.name: Royal Summons
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they must move their king if it has a legal move.

rows.name: Rust
rows.effect: Idle enemy pieces seize up: any enemy piece (never a king) that has stood still for 2 of your opponent's turns rusts solid and may only move if the move is a capture, until it finally moves.

rows.name: Sealed Avenues
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot enter any square on the d or e files for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Serpent Brood
rows.effect: Venomous stone serpents coil around the enemy clergy: every one of your opponent's bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the venom lingers so no enemy bishop may capture for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Statue Garden
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, shuffling one square at a time. The first one struck petrifies only after your opponent's next move, and escapes if they move it away.
rows.action: keep: minors walnut 3 turns; Stone Garden redesigned wider and briefer

rows.name: Stone Bastions
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and each stone bastion seals its ground: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto the files their petrified rooks stand on.

rows.name: Stone Riders
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, their knights turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and the stone is catching: on each of those turns one random enemy piece standing beside a stone rider is petrified for 1 turn too.

rows.name: The Big Chill
rows.effect: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for one of their turns. As the ice lets go, two random survivors turn to walnuts, able to shuffle only one square at a time, for one more of their turns.

rows.name: Thorn Hedge
rows.effect: A hedge of black thorns walls off your realm: enemy bishops, rooks, and queens cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Wall of Thorns
rows.effect: A thicket of thorns bursts up around one of your pieces: the up to 8 squares surrounding it are barred to your opponent for 3 of their turns. If your opponent captures that piece, the wall of thorns falls at once.

rows.name: Walnut Curse
rows.effect: Their greed turns to wood: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece becomes a walnut for 3 of their turns, able only to shuffle one square at a time. Kings shrug the curse off.
rows.action: keep: capture-triggered walnut (working as designed; the failing sim was asserting a retired instant design and was updated)

rows.name: Hellfire Beam
rows.effect: The beam scorches one diagonal: pick a square and choose one of the two diagonals through it. Every empty square along it burns: your opponent cannot move onto them for their next 2 turns. Any enemy piece already on the diagonal may leave normally.

rows.name: Chisel Curse
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, turn the enemy piece you targeted into a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the enemy pieces then directly to its left and right into walnuts for 2 of their turns each. Kings are never affected.

rows.name: Cockatrice Gaze
rows.effect: Every enemy knight and bishop in your half turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns. Minors still in their own half only catch the reflection and are frozen for 1 turn. The first piece the gaze lands on petrifies only after their next move, and escapes if moved.

rows.name: Contagion
rows.effect: The strain lies dormant until after your opponent's next move. Once it wakes, whenever one of their pieces is newly frozen, one adjacent enemy piece, never a king, catches it and is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Court in Exile
rows.effect: On your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king, and their queen is the last to return from exile: she cannot move for 2 further turns after the court comes back.

rows.name: King's Moat
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns none of their pieces may move onto a square next to your king.

rows.name: Frozen Solid
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece and one enemy piece next to it for 3 of their turns each. Kings cannot be chosen. The piece you target freezes only after your opponent's next move, and escapes if they move it away.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Glacial Tomb
rows.effect: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 1 of their turns. As the ice lifts, only their queen and rooks stay behind as walnuts for 1 more turn, able to shuffle only one square at a time.

rows.name: Grand Malediction
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn.

rows.name: Hex of Stone
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's knights and bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, though the first affected piece may make one move first. For those same 4 turns their rooks and queen may slide no more than two squares.

rows.name: Crown of Thorns
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, any enemy piece whose move leaves your king in check is seized by the thorns and frozen for 2 of their turns where it stands. The check still counts; the attacker is simply rooted.

rows.name: The Hollow Crown
rows.effect: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent's king moves, castling included, the court mourns: on their following turn they may move only pawns or the king.

rows.name: Tide of Ash
rows.effect: Their 1st rank is buried at once, and the tide swallows one more home rank on each of their next 3 turns, up to their 4th. No enemy piece may move ONTO buried ground, but a piece already standing in it may leave normally. It blows away after their 6th turn.

rows.name: Doomed Vow
rows.effect: Condemn one enemy piece: in 4 of their turns it is dragged off the board, unless their own king comes to stand on a square next to it first, which breaks the vow at once. Kings themselves cannot be condemned.

rows.name: The Long Eclipse
rows.effect: It holds off until after their next move. Then for their next 3 turns nothing seems wrong, and for the 3 turns after that their bishops and queen are blind and cannot move at all. Knights, rooks, pawns and king see fine throughout.

rows.name: The Enemy Within
rows.effect: Whisper treason to one enemy rook or queen. It holds off until after their next move, then over the next 8 of their turns the third time they move that piece it defects: it serves you for your next 4 turns, then returns. Kings never turn.

rows.name: Feeding Frenzy
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns their bishops, rooks and queen have their reach capped, and the cap tightens for every other curse already afflicting them: each frozen or petrified piece, sealed square, or royal edict.

rows.name: Pyrrhic Toll
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, each time any of their pieces captures, the army mourns and one of their other pieces is frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings never mourn.

rows.name: Broken Supply
rows.effect: Their supply wagon is looted: your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified. They still pick; the card does nothing.
rows.action: REBALANCED: nullifies 3 cards; 2 duplicated Hexed Satchel (T5)

rows.name: Clipped Diagonals
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their bishops and queen may slide at most 2 squares along diagonals. Straight queen moves are untouched. The first piece the clip would rein in may slide freely once, then it binds fully.

rows.name: Command Paralysis
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns they may only move pieces standing in your half of the board. The first piece the silence would stop may move once regardless, then it binds fully. If they have none in your half, they move freely that turn.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Crossbow Curfew
rows.effect: Ranged warfare is outlawed: after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns they may only capture from 1 square away. Long range kills are forbidden.

rows.name: Crown Malaise
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their queen is bedridden every other turn (the 1st and 3rd) and cannot move on those turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Eclipse
rows.effect: The sun goes out over their camp: their pawns cannot advance for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Field of Spears
rows.effect: Your pawns raise a hedge of spears: for your opponent's next 3 turns, their pieces may not stop on any square one of your pawns attacks. A piece already standing on such a square may leave it freely. Their king is exempt.

rows.name: Flooded Flanks
rows.effect: Both edge files (a and h) flood: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on them for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Glass Floor
rows.effect: Every dark square becomes thin glass: for your opponent's next 2 turns their pieces may not stop on dark squares. Their king is exempt.

rows.name: Gorgon Field
rows.effect: A gorgon's gaze sweeps the middle of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move on the central 4x4 (c3 to f6) becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns. Kings resist the gaze.

rows.name: Grim Procession
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns, no piece of theirs may end a move farther from their own king than it started. The army huddles toward the crown. Their king walks free.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Muster of Silence
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs that is defended by another of their pieces may not move. Only the unguarded stragglers may act. Their king is exempt.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Royal Quarantine
rows.effect: Their king is declared contagious: for your opponent's next 4 turns, none of their pieces may end a move adjacent to their own king. The king itself moves freely. The first piece the quarantine would turn away may make one such move, then it binds fully.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Scorched Diagonal
rows.effect: The great a1 to h8 diagonal burns: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on its 8 squares for their next 3 turns, save one bridge square left cool. Since the defender cannot pick here, the bridge is the diagonal square nearest their king.

rows.name: Stone Orchard
rows.effect: All of your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 1 of their turns: heavy nuts that can only shuffle one square. One resists: the affected piece nearest the a1 corner keeps its footing.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: The Long Night
rows.effect: Darkness swallows their camp: for your opponent's next 2 turns, every piece they own may move at most 1 square. Pieces already standing in their own half may leave normally, and king captures are always allowed.

rows.name: Treacle Tide
rows.effect: Treacle seeps in slowly: your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 4 turns, any piece of theirs standing in their own half may move at most 1 square. Their king is exempt, and pieces already in your half are free.

rows.name: Veil of Moths
rows.effect: A living veil settles over your half of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, they cannot capture anything standing in your half.
rows.action: REBALANCED: 4 turns; Withered Hands (full capture ban, 3 turns, same tier) no longer strictly dominates

rows.name: Watchman's Whistle
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 5 turns, any piece of theirs that gives check to your king is arrested on the spot and frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings are never arrested.

rows.name: Wheel of Ice
rows.effect: A ribbon of ice sweeps one file per turn, starting at the a-file: for your opponent's next 4 turns, their pieces on the current icy file cannot move. Their king is exempt. The first piece the ice would pin may move once, then it binds fully.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Leaden Limbs
rows.effect: Your opponent may move each piece at most one square in any direction for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Molten Heart
rows.effect: Their blades run molten: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece is destroyed along with its victim. Their single most valuable piece is exempt and captures freely, and kings burn nothing and are never destroyed.

rows.name: Noble Rout
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, the nobles break and run: for their following 3 turns their knights, bishops, rooks and queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Only their pawns and king may still advance.

rows.name: Stone Prelates
rows.effect: The pews claim whoever lingers: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any of their bishops standing in their own half may only shuffle one square at a time. Bishops that cross into your half move freely.

rows.name: Termites
rows.effect: Termites gnaw at your opponent's towers: every 2 of their turns, their rooks lose one more square of reach. The decay stops at a reach of 1, so a rook can always shuffle a single square.

rows.name: Throne and Silence
rows.effect: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king or their single most valuable piece, and their next draft is skipped entirely.

rows.name: Total Whiteout
rows.effect: A blizzard buries every sightline: for their next 3 turns, your opponent's pieces can only capture at arm's length, exactly one square away.

rows.name: Sticky Floor
rows.effect: The whole floor is flypaper: every one of your opponent's pieces may move at most one square for their next 2 turns.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Withered Hands
rows.effect: After your opponent's next move, they cannot capture with any piece for their following 3 turns.
rows.action: keep: full capture ban T7; Veil of Moths now runs 4 turns on the half-board axis

rows.name: Abdication Edict
rows.effect: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king. For the two turns after that, they may also move their single most valuable non-king piece, chosen fresh each turn; every other piece stays stuck fast.
rows.action: keep: reviewed tier ladder; higher rungs pay more (magnitude, scope, extra rider, or free-action timing)

rows.name: Absolute Zero
rows.effect: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king and pawns for 2 of their turns. The cold outlives the ice: for their next 2 turns after the thaw, each of those pieces can only step a single square. Kings and pawns move freely throughout.

rows.name: Blighted Furrows
rows.effect: Every enemy pawn standing in your half rots away and is removed, and their remaining pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns, though the first pawn to try may make one advance before the lock takes hold.

rows.name: Boneca Ambalabu
rows.effect: The tire-frog drags your opponent down: for their next 4 turns none of their pieces may move more than 1 square in a single move.

rows.name: Endless Night
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn. On the turn they return, up to four non-king enemy pieces you choose are frozen for that one turn.

rows.name: Winter Court
rows.effect: Every enemy piece other than the king standing in your half of the board is frozen for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Death Knell
rows.effect: Toll the knell over one enemy piece: in 3 of their turns it crumbles to dust and is removed. The bell accepts one bribe: if the doomed piece captures anything before the last toll, the curse breaks and it lives. Kings cannot be tolled.

rows.name: Blood Tithe
rows.effect: It holds off until after their next move, then for their next 6 turns: whenever they capture anything larger than a pawn, one of their own pawns is claimed as tribute and removed from the board. Once they have no pawns left, the tithe goes unpaid.

rows.name: Martyr's Crown
rows.effect: A patient briar guards your king for your opponent's next 6 turns. The first check passes; on the second, every enemy piece standing next to your king is frozen for 2 of their turns and the count resets. Their two best pieces there are spared.

rows.name: Blood Price
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, killing has a price: their first capture in that window costs them their following turn, skipped outright; their second capture instead freezes the capturing piece for 2 of their turns. Kings never freeze.

rows.name: Debt of Crowns
rows.effect: The crown's debts are called in: your opponent's next draft is skipped outright, and in the draft after it one card arrives nullified. Since only the card they pick is nullified, the rest of that offer is protected by their own choice.
rows.action: REBALANCED: skip plus 2 nullified; skip plus 1 duplicated Burned Dispatches (T5)

rows.name: Doomsday Clock
rows.effect: A great clock ticks in full view: after 3 of your opponent's turns, every piece of theirs then standing in your half becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns. If none are there, their most advanced piece is frozen for 1 turn instead.

rows.name: Echo Chamber
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 4 turns, they may not move a piece of the same type as the piece you moved on your previous turn. Their king is always allowed.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Eternal Toll
rows.effect: The border's toll comes late but without mercy: your opponent's next move crosses free, then for their following 6 turns, any piece of theirs that crosses the midline into your half is frozen for 1 of their turns on arrival. Kings cross free.

rows.name: Glass Prison
rows.effect: Seal one enemy rook or queen you target inside a glass bubble: it is frozen for 3 of their turns, in full view and utterly stuck.

rows.name: The Great Glacier
rows.effect: A glacier grinds across their army: every enemy piece except pawns and the king is frozen for 1 of their turns.
