rows.effect: Dress up to three of your pieces (your king excepted) from the trunk, forever (purely decorative). Costumed pieces cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn: nobody hits an actor mid-scene.

rows.name: Crown of Masks
rows.effect: The grand carnival: every one of your pieces (your king excepted) is dressed from the trunk, forever (purely decorative), and none of your pieces can be captured on your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Genie Lamp
rows.effect: Rub the lamp for one random gift, equal odds each: a knight, a bishop or a rook into your pocket, 3 draft rerolls, or 30 seconds on your clock.

rows.name: Coffee
rows.effect: Knock it back: take two extra moves right now, but the jitters hand your opponent one extra move on their reply.

rows.name: Wheel of the Cosmos
rows.effect: Twelve equal segments, spun once. Eight are kind: revive a captured minor, march every pawn, a three card draft, stun two enemy pieces, promote a random pawn to knight, two rerolls, thaw your army, or summon a knight. Four are cruel, up to a defecting pawn.

rows.name: Grandma's Cookies
rows.effect: Every one of your frozen or stuck pieces thaws at once, and each of them cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Cornucopia
rows.effect: The horn tips over: two pawns join your pocket, a knight or a bishop (at random, even odds) joins them, and you gain 1 draft reroll.

rows.name: Gacha Banner
rows.effect: Three pulls, resolved on the spot: 55% common, a random pawn sidesteps; 30% rare, a pawn spawns on your second rank; 12% epic, a random tier 4 card joins your hand; 3% SSR, a random tier 7 card. Pity rule: three commons upgrade the third to epic.

rows.name: Wish Fish
rows.effect: Reel it in and take the wish it grants: 30 seconds on your clock, a new pawn beside your king, or 2 draft rerolls. The fish decides.

rows.name: Devil's Deck
rows.effect: Six cards fanned face up, three drawn at random, all three resolve. The blessings: summon a knight, stun three enemy pieces, revive a captured minor, shield your army for a turn. The two curses: lose a random pawn, or freeze one of your minors for 2 turns.

rows.name: My Cousin From Out of Town
rows.effect: A giant checkers piece visits for 8 of your turns: its square is impassable to absolutely everyone, and after each of your moves it shuffles one square in a random direction. It does not understand the rules and cannot be captured.

rows.name: Pandemonium Carnival
rows.effect: The carnival parks beside the board for 4 of your turns. After every move by either side the wheel spins a minor act: a random pawn wanders sideways, a random piece naps for a turn, a random square is roped off, or confetti falls and nothing happens.

rows.name: The Fool
rows.effect: The Fool takes an empty square nearest the enemy king for 6 of your turns: nobody may enter his square, and after each of your moves there is a 1 in 4 chance an enemy piece beside him is too embarrassed to move on your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Escort Mission
rows.effect: If your king can capture, it must. This activates only after your move 3.

rows.name: Pixie Curse
rows.effect: Your knights cannot move onto an edge square of the board, unless that is your only legal move.

rows.name: Lucky
rows.effect: You have no nerf. A rare gift from the gods of chess.

rows.name: Gentle Shepherds
rows.effect: Your bishops can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Minor Nobility
rows.effect: Your pawns can only promote to knights or bishops, never to queens or rooks.

rows.name: Opening Ceremony
rows.effect: Your fourth move of the game must be a pawn move.

rows.name: Silent Infantry
rows.effect: From your fourth move on, your pawns can't give check: any pawn move that would leave the enemy king in check is forbidden. A pawn may still capture the king itself.

rows.name: Pen Pusher
rows.effect: Your rooks can't capture, unless your king is in check.

rows.name: Teetotaler
rows.effect: You can't capture rooks, unless the rook is giving check.

rows.name: Untitled duck nerf
rows.effect: A duck occupies one random square, marked from the opening turn, all game. No piece may land on it and sliders cannot pass through it, though knights may leap over. If the duck would leave you fewer than three legal moves, it steps aside for that turn.

rows.name: Battle Fatigue
rows.effect: After a piece captures, it can't capture again until it makes a non-capturing move. Capturing a piece that is checking your king is always allowed.

rows.name: Columnar Rooks
rows.effect: The squares your rooks may not slide sideways into are shown from the start. From your second turn on, your rooks glide any distance up and down a file, but can only shuffle one square at a time sideways along a rank.

rows.name: Flat Footed
rows.effect: Your pawns can't advance two squares.

rows.name: Gnome's Bargain
rows.effect: From your fourth move on, you cannot capture with the same type of piece that made your previous capture.

rows.name: Homebody King
rows.effect: Your king can't leave your first two ranks.

rows.name: Just Passing Through
rows.effect: Can't capture on a fixed random rank, shown on the board. The restriction never leaves you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Keep Off the Grass
rows.effect: Starting on your fourth move, your king can't move onto the four center squares.

rows.name: Knights Abroad
rows.effect: Once one of your knights crosses into the enemy half, it can't come back to your own half, except once per game, when no other legal move is available, one knight may return home.

rows.name: Knights Off the Rail
rows.effect: Your knights can't move to the a-file or h-file, unless you have no other legal move, in which case one king move is allowed.

rows.name: Level Headed
rows.effect: Your queen can't move diagonally more than 3 squares, unless you are answering a check.

rows.name: Merciful Queen
rows.effect: Your queen won't cut down the common soldiers: she can't capture pawns, except capturing a pawn that has your king in check is always legal.

rows.name: No Drawbridge
rows.effect: You can't castle.

rows.name: Squeamish
rows.effect: Your pawns can't make the game's first capture.

rows.name: Clean Hands
rows.effect: Your king can't capture anything, unless the captured piece is checking your king. Capturing the checker is always legal.

rows.name: Late Riser
rows.effect: Your queen can't move during your first four moves. From your fifth move on she is free.

rows.name: Rusty Hinges
rows.effect: You can only castle during your first ten moves. From your 11th move on, the castle gate is rusted shut, unless you have no other legal move: then a single emergency castle is allowed, once per game.

rows.name: Prima Donna
rows.effect: Can't have more than one pawn on the same file, except one open file may hold doubled pawns: the file of your most advanced pawn (ties break to the lower file).

rows.name: Queen Bee
rows.effect: Once you capture with your queen, you can no longer move queens. This activates only after your move 3.

rows.name: Quit Horsing Around
rows.effect: If you moved a knight last move, you can't move a knight this move.

rows.name: Rook Buddies
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move while any piece sits between them on your home rank; clear the back rank between them first.

rows.name: Sacred File
rows.effect: A random file is sacred, shown from the start. From your second turn on, you can't capture on it, unless the ban would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Separation Anxiety
rows.effect: Pawns adjacent to your king can't move away from him.

rows.name: Soft Paws
rows.effect: Your knights can't capture pawns, except one pawn, once per game.

rows.name: Edge-Shy Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can't move onto the a-file or the h-file.

rows.name: Gentle Giant
rows.effect: Your queen can't capture pawns, unless your king is in check.

rows.name: Knight Toll
rows.effect: You can't capture with a knight if a knight of yours captured on your previous turn.

rows.name: Moonlit King
rows.effect: Your king can only move to dark squares.

rows.name: No Takebacks
rows.effect: You can't move a piece to the exact square your last move started from.

rows.name: Sabbath
rows.effect: On every 7th turn of yours, you can't capture, except a capture that gets your king out of check is always legal.

rows.name: Wallflower
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move onto the four center squares (d4, d5, e4, e5).

rows.name: Anchored Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks may leave your back rank, but once a rook has left it, that rook can never return to it.
rows.action: keep: reviewed same-tier cluster; members differ by a real axis (file band, direction, piece class, trigger, query, or cosmetic skin)

rows.name: Artillery
rows.effect: Rooks must capture at distance ≥ 4.

rows.name: Blinded by the Sun
rows.effect: Can't end your turn attacking a fixed random square, shown on the board. The restriction never leaves you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Cautious Cavalry
rows.effect: The enemy half of the board is shown from the start. From your second turn on, your knights can't cross into it.

rows.name: Cavalry Charge
rows.effect: Your knights can't move backward toward your own side, except if no other legal move is available, your king may move.

rows.name: Cess
rows.effect: You can't move to the h-file.

rows.name: Comfort Zone
rows.effect: If at least three of your moves reach the revealed random square, you must move to it. Next turn's square is shown a turn early.

rows.name: Cramped Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move more than 4 squares, except one longer rook move is allowed once per game.

rows.name: Diplomatic Immunity
rows.effect: Can't capture a piece that just moved, unless that move was a capture. While your king is in check, this restriction is paused for the move.

rows.name: Evil Twin
rows.effect: If you can capture a piece with a same-type piece, you must. This activates only after your move 3.

rows.name: Famine
rows.effect: After move 15, you can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Selkie Skin
rows.effect: Your rooks cannot move more than 3 squares along a file. Moves along a rank are free.

rows.name: Ichthyophobe
rows.effect: From your move 3 on, you cannot play the move a simple greedy engine would pick: its single best move on a one-ply look, the most valuable safe capture, or a basic developing move when there is no capture. Every other legal move is fine.

rows.name: Kingfisher
rows.effect: Starting after your third move, when your king can capture it must dive for the richest prize: it has to take the most valuable enemy piece within its reach.

rows.name: No Free Lunch
rows.effect: No even trades: you can't capture a piece worth exactly as much as the piece making the capture, except capturing a piece that has your king in check is always legal.

rows.name: No Retreat
rows.effect: Your king can't step backward toward your own back rank.

rows.name: No Stone Cutting
rows.effect: You can't capture bishops.

rows.name: Cold Trail
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto the square your opponent's last move just left.

rows.name: One Way Bishops
rows.effect: The squares your bishops may not quietly retreat into are shown from the start. From your second turn on, your bishops can't retreat on a quiet move, but they may still strike backward: a bishop may only lose rank when the move is a capture.

rows.name: Orthodox King
rows.effect: Your king can only move horizontally or vertically, never diagonally, except if no other legal move is available, your king may move diagonally.

rows.name: Outflanked
rows.effect: You can't capture on the rim. The enemy king is fair game anywhere, and you may always capture the piece checking your king.

rows.name: Pawn Ceiling
rows.effect: Starting on your fourth move, your pawns can't move past the middle of the board.

rows.name: Prince Charming
rows.effect: If your queen is attacked, must move a knight if possible.

rows.name: Professional Courtesy
rows.effect: Non-pawn pieces can't capture pieces of their own type.

rows.name: Promotion Phobia
rows.effect: Your pawns can't promote, so they can't advance onto the back rank. A pawn already on the back rank may still move away normally.

rows.name: Protected Pawns
rows.effect: Can only move pawns to defended squares.

rows.name: Pull of the Center
rows.effect: Your pawns can only capture toward the center files.

rows.name: Right Handed
rows.effect: You can't move to the a-file, except once per game.

rows.name: Royal Bloodlust
rows.effect: The turn after your king captures, you must make a capture with any piece if you can.

rows.name: Rusty Knights
rows.effect: Knights can only move once every other turn.

rows.name: Separation of Church and State
rows.effect: Can't move bishops next to a king and can't move king next to a bishop.

rows.name: Skittish
rows.effect: While in check, you must move your king.

rows.name: Sleepy King
rows.effect: Your king can only move when in check.

rows.name: Snipers
rows.effect: Bishops can only capture from distance ≥ 4.

rows.name: Switchback
rows.effect: You can't move in the exact same direction (same file and rank step) twice in a row.

rows.name: Vegan
rows.effect: You can't capture knights, unless the knight is the piece checking your king.

rows.name: No Going Home
rows.effect: Your non-pawn pieces can't move back onto your own back rank.

rows.name: Active Volcano
rows.effect: Can't move onto or orthogonally adjacent to a fixed random square, shown on the board. The restriction never leaves you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Advancing Faith
rows.effect: Your bishops must gain ground on every move: each bishop move has to advance toward the enemy, never staying level and never falling back, except a bishop move that gets your king out of check is always allowed.

rows.name: Barbarian Rage
rows.effect: If you captured last move, you must capture this move if able. Once per game, when every available capture would lose material, the rage relents and you may play any move; that exemption is used up the first time you make a non-capturing move while enraged.

rows.name: Bishop Tunnel Vision
rows.effect: Your bishops can't move more than three squares in a single move, unless the move gives check.

rows.name: Clergy
rows.effect: Your bishops can't move backward toward your own side; each bishop move must stay level or advance toward the enemy.

rows.name: Cloistered Queen
rows.effect: Your queen cannot move until you castle or reach your 12th move, whichever comes first.

rows.name: Conscientious Objectors
rows.effect: Your pawns can't capture, unless the target is the piece checking your king.

rows.name: Court Martial
rows.effect: A piece that's attacked at turn start can't capture.

rows.name: Covering Fire
rows.effect: Can only capture a piece if you can capture it two different ways.

rows.name: Crossing the Rubicon
rows.effect: Once a piece crosses to the opponent's half, it can't return.

rows.name: Crusade
rows.effect: For 4 moves starting on a random move (announced a turn early), if at least three of your moves reach a specific random square, you must move to it.

rows.name: Elephants Fear Mice
rows.effect: Your non-pawn pieces can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Far Sighted
rows.effect: You can't capture a piece standing right next to the capturing piece; captures must reach at least 2 squares away. The one exception: you may always capture the piece checking your king.

rows.name: Troll's Toll
rows.effect: After you capture a pawn, your next move must be a pawn move, if you have one.

rows.name: Frozen Cavalry
rows.effect: From your 18th move on, you can't move your knights, except for a single once-per-game knight move.

rows.name: Goldfish
rows.effect: You can't move a piece you moved 3 turns ago.

rows.name: Greedy
rows.effect: You can't capture a lesser piece when a higher-value capture is on the table. You may still play a quiet move.

rows.name: Haunted
rows.effect: Can't move to a square where you've previously captured.

rows.name: Hipster
rows.effect: You can't move the same piece type as your opponent's last move.

rows.name: Horse Tranquilizer
rows.effect: Your knights can't capture.

rows.name: Hungry Pawns
rows.effect: Whenever one of your pawns can capture, you must make a capture with a pawn.

rows.name: Knight Parade
rows.effect: You must move each knight at least once before moving the same knight twice.

rows.name: Lethal Attraction
rows.effect: Can't make moves that move a piece farther from opponent's king than it started.

rows.name: Monastic Vows
rows.effect: Your bishops can't capture, except capturing a piece that has your king in check is always legal.

rows.name: No Retreat Rooks
rows.effect: From your 10th move on, your rooks can't move toward your own back rank, except for a single once-per-game move.

rows.name: No Shuffling
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move sideways.

rows.name: Oddball
rows.effect: Can only capture on odd-numbered moves.

rows.name: Overzealous
rows.effect: You lose if you capture more than 10 enemy pieces. The count is only checked after your sixth move.

rows.name: Pawn Duty
rows.effect: Every third turn, you must move a pawn.

rows.name: Peons First
rows.effect: Can't move pieces that are one square behind one of your pawns.

rows.name: Punching Down
rows.effect: Pieces can't capture pieces worth more than themselves.

rows.name: Quarantine
rows.effect: You can't move a piece into your own first two ranks from outside them (pieces already on those ranks may still move within them). Separately, while your king is in check, only your king may move.

rows.name: Queen Disguise
rows.effect: Your queen is secretly either a rook or a bishop. Once you move it like one, you can't move it like the other.

rows.name: Queen Fatigue
rows.effect: You lose if you move your queen more than 12 times. The count is only checked after your sixth move.

rows.name: Queen Grounded
rows.effect: From your 12th move on, your queen can't move into the opponent's half of the board, except for a single once-per-game move.

rows.name: Quicksand
rows.effect: The 4th and 5th ranks are quicksand, shown on the board. If one of your pieces lands on the same 4th- or 5th-rank square for the second time in the game, tracing that piece's own path, it is stuck there for good and can never move again.

rows.name: Remorseful
rows.effect: Can't capture twice in a row.

rows.name: Royal Berth
rows.effect: Can't place a piece adjacent to your king.

rows.name: Royal Guard
rows.effect: Your non-king pieces that are adjacent to your king at the start of your turn can't move. The king itself may still move.

rows.name: Royal Jubilee
rows.effect: Whenever you capture a non-pawn, you must move your king or queen on the next move.

rows.name: Secret Garden
rows.effect: Two random garden zones (each a 3-file-wide, 3-rank-deep block in front of one of your pawns, shown as marked squares) are off limits for the whole game: you can't move any piece onto those squares.

rows.name: Shadow Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can only move to dark squares.

rows.name: Shellshocked
rows.effect: When opponent captures, pieces adjacent to the captured square can't move next turn.

rows.name: Short Leash Knights
rows.effect: Your knights may never move beyond your own first three ranks.

rows.name: Sibling Rivalry
rows.effect: Can't move a piece adjacent to an opponent's piece of same type.

rows.name: Sidewinder
rows.effect: Your rooks can only move horizontally along ranks, never up or down files, except one vertical move is allowed once per game.

rows.name: Simplifier
rows.effect: If you can capture with an equal- or lesser-value piece, you must.

rows.name: Spice of Life
rows.effect: You can't move the same piece type twice in a row.

rows.name: Stir Crazy
rows.effect: If you haven't moved your king for 4 turns, you must on the 5th.

rows.name: Stop Stalling
rows.effect: Your pieces can't move laterally.

rows.name: Superstitious
rows.effect: Can't move to a square where opponent has captured.

rows.name: Tidy Desk
rows.effect: By move 25, you must have at least one piece on every rank of your half but one; you may leave a single rank of your choosing open.

rows.name: Timid
rows.effect: Your pieces can't capture an enemy worth more than the capturing piece, unless that capturing piece is itself under enemy attack.

rows.name: Torpedoes
rows.effect: If you made a non-capturing pawn move last turn and can move it again, you must, unless every such continuation would hang the pawn (leave it attacked and undefended), in which case the compulsion relents and you may play any move.

rows.name: Tripwire
rows.effect: A random rank is a tripwire, shown from the start. From your second turn on, you can't cross it backwards, unless the ban would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Truant
rows.effect: You can't move the same piece twice in a row.

rows.name: True Gentleman
rows.effect: You can't capture queens.

rows.name: Vampiric
rows.effect: You can only capture on dark squares, starting on your second move. The forbidden light squares are shown from the start.

rows.name: Vertigo
rows.effect: Can't move a piece more than 2 ranks in one move.
rows.action: keep: diagonal-only constraint at T4, different geometry

rows.name: Winds of Fate
rows.effect: Each turn you randomly can't move left or can't move right, revealed a turn early. The restriction is dropped whenever it would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Flinch
rows.effect: While your king is in check, you can't capture; you have to get out another way.

rows.name: Lonely King
rows.effect: Your king can't move to a square adjacent to one of your own pieces.

rows.name: Pawn Shy
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto a square guarded by an enemy pawn.

rows.name: Quarantine Zone
rows.effect: A random 2x2 block of squares is sealed off, shown from the first turn; you can't move any piece onto it, unless the seal would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Shifting Sands
rows.effect: Each turn, a random file is closed; you can't move any piece onto it this turn, unless the closure would leave you fewer than three legal moves. Next turn's closed file is revealed a turn early.

rows.name: Short Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can't move more than 4 squares in a single move.

rows.name: Slow Burn
rows.effect: You can't capture anything before your 6th move.

rows.name: Slow Start
rows.effect: For your first 6 moves, you can only move pawns and knights.

rows.name: Stampede
rows.effect: If you moved a knight on your last turn, you must move a knight again this turn (if you can).

rows.name: Tax Season
rows.effect: Every 6th turn of yours, if you can capture, you must.

rows.name: Alternator
rows.effect: You must alternate pawn moves and non-pawn moves.

rows.name: Armory
rows.effect: Your rooks must stay defended at all times.

rows.name: Bipartisanship
rows.effect: Can't move left twice in a row or right twice in a row.

rows.name: Boxing with Shadow
rows.effect: From your move 4 on, when opponent moves, if you can move to the square they vacated, you must.

rows.name: Broadside Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks glide any distance sideways along a rank, but can only inch one square at a time up or down a file.

rows.name: Caged Queen
rows.effect: Until you have made 12 moves your queen may not leave your back rank; after that she may leave it but can never cross the midline into the enemy half.

rows.name: Carnivore Bishops
rows.effect: Starting on your fourth move, your bishops can only move when they capture.

rows.name: Castle Curfew
rows.effect: You lose if you have not castled by your 20th move. On your 20th move you get a visible warning if you still have not castled.

rows.name: Chivalry
rows.effect: Can only capture heavies (rooks, queens) with a knight. This activates only after your move 3.

rows.name: Closed Book
rows.effect: You lose if two or more files ever have none of your pawns on them.

rows.name: Control Center
rows.effect: Non-capturing moves must go to files c, d, e, or f, unless the piece already starts on those files, in which case it may leave normally.

rows.name: Court Jester
rows.effect: Your queen can only move like a knight.

rows.name: Crenellations
rows.effect: Pawns can only move to a fixed random color of squares, shown from the start. The restriction is dropped whenever it would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Crippled Clergy
rows.effect: Each bishop of yours shuffles: every bishop move covers a single diagonal step.

rows.name: Entrenched
rows.effect: Rooks can't move more than 2 squares.

rows.name: Even Keeled
rows.effect: Can only capture on even-numbered moves.

rows.name: Fair Fight
rows.effect: You can't capture a piece worth less than the piece making the capture; no bullying weaker pieces, only equal or stronger prey.

rows.name: Femme Fatale
rows.effect: You can only capture the enemy king with your queen.

rows.name: Banshee Bond
rows.effect: Your queen may only move to a square next to one of your other pieces. If she has no such move, she stays put.

rows.name: Gambler
rows.effect: Can't move a specific piece type, re-randomized each turn and revealed one turn early. The ban is dropped whenever it would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Get Down Mr. President
rows.effect: Can't move your king while in check.

rows.name: Half a Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can only move like a rook, never diagonally, except one diagonal move is allowed once per game.

rows.name: Heavy Boots
rows.effect: All non-pawn moves are distance ≤ 3.

rows.name: Hobbled Knights
rows.effect: Your knights can't advance toward the enemy side; their rank may never increase.

rows.name: Homebound Pawns
rows.effect: From your fourth move on, your pawns can't advance past the halfway line unless the move is a capture; only by force can they cross into enemy soil.

rows.name: Honey Trap
rows.effect: Your queen can't move unless she is currently under attack by an enemy piece.

rows.name: Inside the Lines
rows.effect: You can't move ONTO the rim. Pieces already on the rim may stay there.

rows.name: Irresistible
rows.effect: If you can move a piece adjacent to the opponent's king (that isn't already), you must, unless every such move would hang the piece (leave it attacked and undefended), in which case the pull relents and you may play any move.

rows.name: Ladies First
rows.effect: Can only move king if you moved queen on previous turn.

rows.name: Leading the Charge
rows.effect: As long as you have a knight, non-knights can't be ahead of your most advanced knight.

rows.name: March or Die
rows.effect: You lose if four of your turns pass in a row without you moving a pawn.

rows.name: Messy Divorce
rows.effect: Pieces can't move from queenside to kingside or vice versa.

rows.name: Mirror March
rows.effect: Your move must go the same file direction (left or right) as your opponent's last move, except a piece already on the edge file in that direction may move any way.

rows.name: Moving Day
rows.effect: After turn 20, no piece may be on your home row.

rows.name: Myopic Bishops
rows.effect: From your fourth move on, your bishops can't move more than two squares.

rows.name: One Bite at a Time
rows.effect: After a capture, you can't capture again for two of your turns, except your chosen pawn (on a random file, shown from the start) may still capture.

rows.name: Out of Breath
rows.effect: You can only move your king once the entire game.

rows.name: Pack Mentality
rows.effect: Pieces must move to squares adjacent to another of your pieces.

rows.name: Pacman
rows.effect: If you can capture a pawn, you must.

rows.name: Phobia of Edges
rows.effect: If a piece is on the rim, it must move.

rows.name: Power Cells
rows.effect: Can't move a piece farther than the number of pawns you have.

rows.name: Predatory Knights
rows.effect: Your knights can only move by capturing, except that every third turn a knight with no capture may make one quiet move.

rows.name: Restless Crown
rows.effect: Your king may move only six times all game. One compliance token excuses a single extra king move; you lose only on his eighth move.

rows.name: Retreating Bishops
rows.effect: Your bishops can only retreat toward your own back rank, but once per game a bishop may make one non-retreating move.

rows.name: Retrograde Knights
rows.effect: Your knights can only move homeward, toward your own side, and can never advance, except that each knight's first move off its home square is exempt from the homeward rule.

rows.name: Rook on the Seventh
rows.effect: By move 15, you must get a rook to your 7th rank. Once a rook has reached it, that rook may leave normally without breaking the pledge.

rows.name: Scholarship
rows.effect: You can only move a piece type after the opponent has moved it once.

rows.name: Scouting Ahead
rows.effect: As long as you have a pawn, non-pawns can't go ahead of your most advanced pawn.

rows.name: Shapeshifter
rows.effect: For your first 3 moves the queen moves normally. From then on she is a bishop; capturing a non-pawn turns her into a copy of that piece, and capturing a knight freezes her.

rows.name: Solar Flare
rows.effect: The flare burns for 3 of your turns, then sleeps for 2, over and over. While it burns you can only capture on light squares. The dark squares are shown whenever it is up.

rows.name: Stunted Rooks
rows.effect: From your fourth move on, your rooks can only move one square at a time.

rows.name: Sunrise
rows.effect: On odd turns you must move forward; on even turns you may move freely.

rows.name: Theocracy
rows.effect: On odd/even moves, can only capture with bishops. This activates only after your move 3.

rows.name: Thinning Ranks
rows.effect: You lose if you are ever left with fewer than three pawns. A one-time compliance token excuses the first turn you fall below three, but if you are still below three on your next turn you lose.

rows.name: Three Check
rows.effect: If you have been checked three times total, you lose.

rows.name: Timid Bishops
rows.effect: Your bishops may only move toward your own side; their rank can never advance toward the enemy.

rows.name: Trophy Wife
rows.effect: Your queen can't capture, unless the target is the piece checking your king.

rows.name: War of Attrition
rows.effect: You lose if you ever make more than twelve non-capturing moves in a row. The first time this happens the piece you last moved is frozen for a turn; the second time, you lose.

rows.name: Warlord
rows.effect: From turn 12 onward, your king can't be on your first two ranks. From turn 11, while your king is still on those ranks, you are warned one move early.

rows.name: Whites of Their Eyes
rows.effect: You can only capture within 2 squares (king-steps) of the capturing piece.

rows.name: Curfew
rows.effect: After your 25th move, you can't move any piece into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

rows.name: Glass Jaw
rows.effect: You can't make a move that leaves your queen attacked by the enemy.

rows.name: Meteor Shower
rows.effect: Each turn, five random squares are struck and sealed; you can't move any piece onto them this turn, unless the strike would leave you fewer than three legal moves. Next turn's five squares are revealed a turn early.

rows.name: Absolution
rows.effect: After a non-bishop captures, it must start a turn adjacent to a bishop before it can capture again. If that would leave you no legal move, a king move is allowed.

rows.name: Ascetic
rows.effect: You can capture at most one piece per piece type. If no move complies, your king may move instead.

rows.name: Bishop Fan Club
rows.effect: Must promote to bishops. King and queen can only move diagonally.

rows.name: Blood Quota
rows.effect: You may make only six captures all game. One compliance token excuses a single extra capture; you lose only when you make an eighth capture.

rows.name: Bloodthirsty
rows.effect: After turn 3, if you go 2 turns without capturing, you must capture if able. No move granted by another card can dodge the required capture.

rows.name: Bridge Over Troubled Water
rows.effect: A river runs through the middle. From your move 4 on, cross only via the center files.

rows.name: Burning Bridges
rows.effect: Your bishops, rooks, and queen can't travel over a square they have already passed over earlier in the game.

rows.name: Centralized Command
rows.effect: Can only capture if you moved your king in the last 3 turns. If that would leave you no legal move, a king move is allowed.

rows.name: Checkers
rows.effect: Must capture if able. Your king is exempt: a king move is always allowed instead.

rows.name: Cheerleaders
rows.effect: Non-pawns can only capture if adjacent to one of your pawns.

rows.name: Colorblind
rows.effect: Can't move to one random color of squares, re-randomized each turn and revealed one turn early. The restriction is dropped whenever it would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Cowardly
rows.effect: When the opponent captures, you must move backward. The first time you fail to retreat you get a one turn warning; fail to retreat a second time and you lose.

rows.name: Cowering in Fear
rows.effect: Can't move a piece of less value than one opponent has captured from you.

rows.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
rows.effect: Each turn the devil suggests a bad move. Ignore him 7 turns in a row and on the 8th you must obey. A piece a card spawns or teleports in can be the demanded move at once.

rows.name: Doctor Octopus
rows.effect: Can only capture non-king pieces 8 times total.

rows.name: Exclusivity Clause
rows.effect: Can't move to squares more than one of your pieces can move to. Pieces a card spawns or teleports in are counted at once.

rows.name: Eye of Sauron
rows.effect: As long as you have a rook, non-pawns can't go past the rook's farthest sight.

rows.name: Feast or Famine
rows.effect: You lose if ten of your turns pass in a row without you capturing anything.

rows.name: Flatterer
rows.effect: If opponent moves a pawn, you must move a pawn. Same for non-pawns.

rows.name: Wyrm Hoard
rows.effect: You cannot capture a piece worth more than the piece you capture it with. Capturing the king is always allowed.

rows.name: Forward March
rows.effect: You can't move backward.

rows.name: Fresh Faces
rows.effect: Each turn, you must move a piece that hasn't moved yet, until none remain.

rows.name: Friendly Fire
rows.effect: Can only move to squares defended by another of your pieces. A move granted by another card must also land on a defended square.

rows.name: Glorious Battle
rows.effect: On a midgame move drawn at random, the battle begins: for 3 consecutive moves you must capture, or lose.

rows.name: Going the Distance
rows.effect: Must move at least as far as opponent's last move. If nothing reaches that far, a king move is allowed.

rows.name: Guerilla Tactics
rows.effect: After a capturing move, you must return the capturing piece to its previous square if possible.

rows.name: Hand and Brainless
rows.effect: Each turn the voice names a random piece type, and it names next turn's type one turn ahead. You must move the named type, but only while doing so still leaves you at least three legal moves; otherwise you may move anything.

rows.name: Hedonic Treadmill
rows.effect: Must move a piece at least as valuable as opponent's last moved piece.

rows.name: Helicopter Parent
rows.effect: If you end one of your turns with a pawn that is attacked and undefended, you are warned. You lose only if a pawn is still attacked and undefended at the end of your next turn.

rows.name: Hobbled Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can only move one square at a time, like a second king.

rows.name: Hopscotch
rows.effect: Must alternate light/dark destination squares. The required destination color is shown each turn.

rows.name: Horse Eats First
rows.effect: As long as you have a knight, you can only capture with knights. This activates only after your move 3.

rows.name: Icy Squares
rows.effect: Starting on move 4, after you move a piece it must slide once more in the same direction on your next move (if possible). Forced slides don't force another.

rows.name: Inching Forward
rows.effect: After turn 6, king must be in front of home rank. Required rank advances every 6 turns, up to your 7th rank.

rows.name: Indecisive
rows.effect: Pieces can't capture if they have multiple possible capture moves.

rows.name: Jumpy
rows.effect: When possible, must move an attacked piece.

rows.name: King of the Hill
rows.effect: After your first move, you lose unless one of your pieces sits on d4, d5, e4, or e5.

rows.name: Lame Duck
rows.effect: You can't move your king at all.

rows.name: Left for Dead
rows.effect: Can only capture leftward (file decreasing).

rows.name: Left to Right
rows.effect: Unless you just moved to the rightmost file, must move right of your last move's destination. If no rightward move exists, a king move is allowed.

rows.name: Magnetic Kings
rows.effect: When you move your king, it must not end up farther from the enemy king than it started (equal distance is allowed). Moving any other piece is unrestricted.

rows.name: Medusa
rows.effect: Pieces attacked by opponent's queen are stone; they cannot move.

rows.name: Modest
rows.effect: Lose if you have more pieces than opponent.

rows.name: Monkey See
rows.effect: Can only capture with piece types your opponent has captured with. If that leaves no legal move, a king move is allowed.

rows.name: My Kingdom for a Horse
rows.effect: If opponent captures a knight of yours, you lose.

rows.name: No Clean Trades
rows.effect: You can't make a capture if the enemy could immediately recapture on that square. No card effect can make such a capture legal.

rows.name: Obsession
rows.effect: Each turn fixates on a random square, revealed a turn ahead. If at least three of your moves reach the current square, you must play one of them.

rows.name: Paranoid
rows.effect: Your king must always be defended, or you lose. Any piece of yours can be the defender, including pieces a card spawns or teleports in.

rows.name: Reconnaissance
rows.effect: Start unable to capture. After seeing each opponent piece type move, you may capture that type.

rows.name: Relay Race
rows.effect: If you can move a piece adjacent to your last move's destination, you must.

rows.name: Rhythm Master
rows.effect: You must alternate captures and non-captures. If no move complies, your king may move instead.

rows.name: Rook Fan Club
rows.effect: Must promote to rooks. King/queen can't move diagonally.

rows.name: Rooks Charge
rows.effect: Your rooks can only move straight forward toward the enemy, never sideways or backward. If that leaves you with no legal move, you may move your king instead.

rows.name: Savior Complex
rows.effect: When in check, must move your queen, or lose.

rows.name: The Scent of Blood
rows.effect: Any of your pieces that has a capture available can't make a non-capturing move; if you move that piece, it must capture. You may still move a different piece that has no capture. No card effect can grant such a piece a quiet move it would otherwise be denied.

rows.name: Scorched Earth
rows.effect: You can't move to a square you've previously moved FROM.

rows.name: Siege
rows.effect: You must capture at least one enemy rook by move 20. Miss the deadline and you get a one turn warning; if you still have no rook by move 21, you lose.

rows.name: Simon Says
rows.effect: Must move onto same color square as opponent's last move.

rows.name: Simp
rows.effect: You lose if you have no queen.

rows.name: Social Distancing
rows.effect: Can't make non-capturing moves to squares adjacent to opponent pieces. The forbidden ring around enemy pieces is shown on the board.

rows.name: Spread Out
rows.effect: Can't move a non-pawn adjacent to another of your non-pawns. Can't castle.

rows.name: Statue King
rows.effect: Your king can only move to capture; he can never take a quiet, non-capturing step, and no card effect can grant him one.

rows.name: Stay-at-Home Mom
rows.effect: Your queen can only move within your two home ranks.

rows.name: Taking Turns
rows.effect: Can't move a piece a second time until every piece of its type has moved once. A piece a card spawns or teleports in obeys the restriction at once: it counts as an unmoved piece of its type until it makes its own move.

rows.name: Thunderdome
rows.effect: The centre 16 squares (files c to f, ranks 3 to 6) are the thunderdome. Once one of your pieces is inside, it can never leave the zone for the rest of the game, though it may still move within it. A card-granted move cannot carry a piece out either.

rows.name: Toothless Pawns
rows.effect: Your pawns can never capture and can never move two squares.

rows.name: Tribute
rows.effect: Every 8th turn, if you can push a pawn onto a square the enemy attacks, you must. This forced tribute cannot be dodged by card-granted moves.

rows.name: Triple Play
rows.effect: Can only capture the enemy king while you have 3 of a set piece type, shown from the start. The restriction is dropped whenever it would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: True Love
rows.effect: King and queen can only move to squares adjacent to each other.

rows.name: Turn the Other Cheek
rows.effect: Can't recapture.

rows.name: Unrequited Love
rows.effect: King can't move away from queen; queen can't move toward king. If no compliant move exists, a king move is allowed.

rows.name: Vanishing Point
rows.effect: Starting on move 4, your pieces can't move to the same square twice in the game.

rows.name: Windup Toys
rows.effect: After move 12, can't move knights or bishops.

rows.name: Bodyguard
rows.effect: You lose if your king ever has no friendly piece adjacent to it (after your first move).

rows.name: Deadline
rows.effect: You must capture an enemy queen by your 25th move, or you lose. Any enemy queen counts, including one created or spawned mid-game.

rows.name: Equalizer
rows.effect: You lose if your piece count ever differs from your opponent's by more than 3, in either direction. Every piece on the board counts, including any created or spawned mid-game.

rows.name: Follow the Leader
rows.effect: You must move a piece onto the same file as your opponent's last move's destination, if you can.

rows.name: Glass Queen
rows.effect: You lose if you end one of your turns with your queen attacked by the enemy.

rows.name: Gravity
rows.effect: None of your pieces may move more than two ranks ahead of your own king, unless the piece already starts more than two ranks ahead (a piece inside the region may move freely).

rows.name: Mimicry
rows.effect: You must move the same piece type as your opponent's last move, if you can.

rows.name: Weigh Station
rows.effect: Your rooks and queen can't cross into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

rows.name: You Best Not Miss
rows.effect: If you end your turn giving check, you must capture the king next turn or lose.

rows.name: Abstinence
rows.effect: If your opponent ever has two same-type non-pawns adjacent inside your half of the board, you lose.

rows.name: Champing at the Bit
rows.effect: All pawn moves must be distance 2.

rows.name: No Restraint
rows.effect: From your 4th move on, if you can capture you must, and if any available capture also gives check, you must make a checking capture.

rows.name: Constriction
rows.effect: Every 6 of your turns, the playable board loses a rank from the back, up to 3 ranks. This restriction cannot be overridden by card effects.

rows.name: Deer in the Headlights
rows.effect: From your fourth move onward, you can't move pieces that are currently under attack. Your first three moves are free so the opening cannot be soft-locked.

rows.name: Defanged Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can't capture and can't give check.

rows.name: Domino
rows.effect: Each move must end adjacent to your previous move's destination. Spawned and teleported pieces obey this immediately.

rows.name: Drag
rows.effect: Your queen is now royal: if it is captured, you lose.

rows.name: Echo Chamber
rows.effect: Starting on move 4, you must move to the same rank as your last move's destination.

rows.name: Eye for an Eye
rows.effect: If opponent captures, you must capture next turn or lose.

rows.name: Fischer Random Endgame
rows.effect: By move 20, all your non-pawns must be on home row AND on a square they couldn't have started on. Pieces a card spawns or teleports in must comply too.

rows.name: Lich Pact
rows.effect: From your sixth move on, you lose if 6 of your turns pass in a row without one of your pieces ending its move in the enemy half of the board.

rows.name: Iron Curtain
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto the central 16 squares (files c through f, ranks 3 through 6). Card-granted drops and teleports onto those squares are blocked the same way.

rows.name: Ivory Tower
rows.effect: You lose if any opponent piece is adjacent to your king.

rows.name: Leaps and Bounds
rows.effect: Every move must be a leap: a piece can't move to a square adjacent to the square it's leaving. A move granted by another card must also be a leap.

rows.name: Leveling Up
rows.effect: Can't capture a piece type until you've captured its predecessor. A move granted by another card can't make a barred capture legal.

rows.name: No Hanging Pieces
rows.effect: You can't make a move that leaves any of your pieces attacked by the enemy and undefended. Card-granted drops and teleports must obey this too.

rows.name: No Man's Land
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto a square your opponent currently attacks, except once per game you may step onto an attacked square.
rows.action: keep: reviewed cross-pool cluster; twins live in different draft pools (buff vs boon/hex vs opener) or scale by tier within their pool

rows.name: Noble Steed
rows.effect: Non-knight pieces can only move if adjacent to one of your knights.

rows.name: Chameleon
rows.effect: Every move must end on the same colour square it started on. Your knights can never move, your pawns can only double-step or capture, and your king and rooks step diagonally or an even number of squares. With no such move, your king may move anywhere.

rows.name: Grandstanding
rows.effect: Every move you make must be one of the longest available this turn: no legal move may travel farther (in king-steps) than the one you pick. If no full-length move exists, your king may move to any square instead.

rows.name: Metronome
rows.effect: Each move must travel exactly as many squares, in king-steps, as your previous move, whenever such a move exists. A knight's move always counts as two. A spawned or teleported piece must move on the ongoing tempo immediately.

rows.name: Royal Entourage
rows.effect: For your first three moves you may move anything. From your fourth move on, you can only move pieces that start within two king-steps of your own king. Everything farther away stands and waits.

rows.name: Shield Wall
rows.effect: Your king must always end your turn with at least one of your own pawns adjacent to him, or you lose. If the shield is broken on the opponent's turn, you get one move to restore it.

rows.name: Onward Only
rows.effect: From your 4th move on, none of your pieces may move backward toward your own back rank.

rows.name: Pawn Storm
rows.effect: If your last move wasn't a pawn move, you must move a pawn (if possible).

rows.name: Pilgrimage
rows.effect: Your king must reach the opposite back rank by move 30.

rows.name: Reckless Monarch
rows.effect: Whenever your king can step toward the enemy, you must move your king forward.

rows.name: Relentless Hunter
rows.effect: You must give check on every turn you are able to. No card effect can grant a move that escapes this.

rows.name: Rising Water
rows.effect: Every 10 of your turns, water rises one rank from your back rank. You can't move underwater pieces or to underwater squares.

rows.name: Stand Your Ground
rows.effect: Pieces can only capture if attacked.

rows.name: Torchlight
rows.effect: Non-pawns can only move if start or end square is adjacent to one of your pawns.

rows.name: Tower Defense
rows.effect: Can't move rooks. If you lose all rooks, you lose.

rows.name: Unlucky
rows.effect: 20 random squares are unusable each turn, re-randomized and shown on the board. The restriction never leaves you fewer than three legal moves.

rows.name: Unspooling
rows.effect: Total move distance budget = 100. When you run out, you lose.

rows.name: Velociraptor
rows.effect: Can only capture a piece type if opponent moved that type in their last 3 moves. A piece a card spawns or teleports in obeys this at once.

rows.name: Daisy Chain
rows.effect: From your 4th move on, the piece you move must start its move adjacent to the square your last move ended on (if any such move exists).

rows.name: King's Leash
rows.effect: You can't move any piece to a square more than 3 king-steps from your own king. If no compliant move exists, only your king may move.

rows.name: Pin Cushion
rows.effect: You lose if you end one of your turns with two or more of your pieces (other than the king) attacked by the enemy at once.

rows.name: Regicide Clock
rows.effect: You must give check at least once every 6 of your turns, or you lose.

rows.name: Always Check, It Might Be Mate
rows.effect: If you are checked, you lose. A temporary shield or suspension can't spare you: the check is read straight from the board.

rows.name: Boastful
rows.effect: You lose if you end one of your turns with fewer pieces than your opponent.

rows.name: Bottled Lightning
rows.effect: If your king can move forward or sideways, it must, and it may never move backward toward your own side. When every king move would go backward you may move another piece instead, but the move right after any non-king move must be a king move.

rows.name: Counting Sheep
rows.effect: Once you've moved a piece type 5 times, you can't move it again.

rows.name: Death Wish
rows.effect: If your king can move onto a square where it would be captured, it must. When several such squares qualify, the opponent chooses the destination: the king is forced onto the one where it would face the most attackers (ties break to the lowest-numbered square).

rows.name: Eat Your Vegetables
rows.effect: Can't capture non-pawns until opponent has ≤ 4 pawns remaining.

rows.name: Titan's Yoke
rows.effect: On every second turn of yours, you must move your king if it has a legal move.

rows.name: Fog of War
rows.effect: Enemy pieces are hidden by fog. An enemy piece is marked (its square lit) only if it is checking your king or stands within two squares of one of your pieces; everything else stays hidden.

rows.name: Fog of War (extended)
rows.effect: Hide opponent pieces entirely, starting on your move 4. The opening is shown in the clear so it cannot be soft-locked.

rows.name: Glass King
rows.effect: From your move 10 on, your king is exiled from his own back two ranks: he must leave them if he is still there, may never step back onto them, and from that move any check anywhere on the board loses instantly.

rows.name: Hoarder
rows.effect: If you ever have fewer than 8 pawns, you lose the game. Every pawn loss counts, including self-removal and forced card sacrifices.

rows.name: Hold Them Back
rows.effect: You lose the moment any enemy pawn reaches your half of the board.

rows.name: Homeland Security
rows.effect: If opponent enters your two home ranks, you lose.

rows.name: Neat Freak
rows.effect: After move 8, no two of your non-pawn pieces of the same type may share a rank, file, or diagonal. If the opponent's move creates the alignment you get one move to break it; a move of your own that makes or keeps one loses at once.

rows.name: No Retreat Ever
rows.effect: Every move you make must advance toward the enemy; no piece may move backward or even hold its rank, except one non-advancing move is allowed once per game.

rows.name: Nurturer
rows.effect: Can't capture the enemy king until you've promoted a pawn. No card effect can make that capture legal any sooner.

rows.name: Doomsday Clock
rows.effect: You must capture the enemy king by your 30th move, or you lose. From your 12th move on you must also give check at least once every six of your own moves: let six of your moves pass with no check and you lose.

rows.name: Killing Spree
rows.effect: Once you capture, the spree begins: every one of your following turns must also capture, or you lose. Declining an available capture, or starting a turn mid-spree with no capture at all, loses immediately. Capturing the enemy king ends the spree in victory.

rows.name: Pyrrhic Victories
rows.effect: Any of your pieces that captures turns to stone and can never move again; a petrified piece can still be captured by your opponent. Your king is immune to the curse.

rows.name: Own Half Only
rows.effect: You can't move any piece past your own fourth rank; the enemy half of the board is off limits. Spawned pieces and teleports can't bypass the boundary either.

rows.name: Pawns Do the Dirty Work
rows.effect: Only your pawns may capture; none of your other pieces can capture.

rows.name: Reflective
rows.effect: From your move 4 on, non-pawns must move to squares whose mirror across the center is occupied. The first three moves are free so the opening cannot be soft-locked.

rows.name: Respectful
rows.effect: You can't end your turn giving check. Once per game, if every legal move would give check, you may give check that one time.

rows.name: Serf Labor
rows.effect: You can only move your pawns and your king. No other piece may ever move.

rows.name: Slowpoke
rows.effect: All your moves must be distance exactly 1. On every fifth turn, a single knight leap is allowed instead.

rows.name: Straight and Narrow
rows.effect: You can't make any diagonal move: your bishops are stuck, your queen moves only like a rook, and your pawns can't capture.

rows.name: Total Pacifism
rows.effect: You can never capture an enemy piece, except the king to win. No card effect can capture on your behalf either, except one that captures the king.

rows.name: Wagon Train
rows.effect: Keep the wagons together: each move must land within one file and one rank of your previous move's destination. A knight may leap out of the convoy only on a turn when no such move exists.

rows.name: War Footing
rows.effect: You lose if you make more than 12 non-capturing moves all game.

rows.name: Bottom Feeder
rows.effect: You can only capture pawns. You can't capture any other piece, except the enemy king to win.

rows.name: The Floor Is Lava
rows.effect: Each turn, three random ranks turn to lava and you cannot move a piece from or onto them. While any of your pieces stands on a rank that will ignite next turn, your move must take a piece off an igniting rank, or you lose.

rows.name: Glass Army
rows.effect: You lose the moment the opponent captures any of your non-pawn pieces (knight, bishop, rook, or queen).

rows.name: House of Cards
rows.effect: From your 5th move on, you lose if you end one of your turns with any of your pieces or pawns (other than the king) attacked and undefended.

rows.name: Kingpin
rows.effect: Only your king may capture. No other piece can make a capture. If no compliant move exists, only your king may move.

rows.name: Perfect Defense
rows.effect: You can't make any move that leaves one of your pieces (other than the king) standing on a square the enemy attacks, even if it is defended.

rows.name: Royal Meridian
rows.effect: Every piece you move must land on your king's file or your king's rank. If no compliant move exists, only your king may move.
